record.description: A two-level cat window perch that mounts on glass with suction cups and sits at the top of a window for sunbathing and watching outdoors. The metal frame is sturdy, the plush mattress comes off for washing, and the adjustable height gives cats room to stand on the lower layer.
Women's slip-on slipper from Merrell in black, sized 5 medium US. Features a Select GRIP outsole designed to provide durable traction on a range of surfaces.

specs.care: Machine washable, cold water, gentle cycle, low tumble dry

record.description: A long buffalo plaid table runner with a farmhouse look, suited to banquet, dining, and buffet tables. Made from a cotton and polyester blend, it can be machine washed and is suitable for many occasions, from holidays to parties and everyday dining.

specs.package dimensions: 2.8 L x 4.8 W x 13 H cm

record.description: A black Harley Tec X Linerlock from Case, listed as sporting goods and made in China. The compact package measures about 2.8 by 4.8 by 13 centimeters and weighs roughly 0.14 kilograms.

specs.features: Built-in water bottle holder and phone/accessory holder

record.description: An indoor stationary exercise bike for cardio workouts at home. Resistance is set manually through a 30-pound flywheel, and the padded seat and handlebars both adjust to suit different body sizes. Includes a water bottle holder and a phone or accessory holder.

A lightweight camouflage backpack designed for elementary school children. It offers multiple compartments with zippers, including a laptop sleeve and mesh side pockets for a water bottle. Padded adjustable straps and a top handle make it easy to carry daily.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

record.description: Airy linen-blend curtain panels with a natural, textured look and a simple dove-toned pattern. Each panel has nickel grommets for easy hanging and is designed to diffuse daylight while offering a degree of privacy. Sold as a set of two panels for living rooms, bedrooms, and other spaces.

Nail polish in the Iris Illusion shade from Sally Hansen's Xtreme Wear line. The listing describes a durable, hard-wearing formula that delivers strong color and shine, sold in a 0.4 fluid ounce bottle as a single unit.

specs.care: Wipe with damp cloth, towel dry

record.description: A countertop mug tree that holds six cups by their handles, suiting a range of ceramic, glass, and teacup sizes. Its curved branches keep mugs steady, and the looped top makes it easy to carry. Store mugs upright to free up cabinet space for a tidy coffee station.

specs.fit features: Mighty Back bi-swing between shoulders; flex elbow

record.description: A men's jacket from Carhartt's Full Swing Cryder line with a water-repellent finish and stretch fabric for easier movement. Its back panel and elbow design are intended to reduce restriction when you bend, reach, and move about.

specs.included: 1 laundry basket and 2 removable dirty clothes bags

record.description: A tall collapsible laundry hamper with a handle, built from thick 600D Oxford fabric and held upright by four fiber rods. Two removable bags let you swap out full loads quickly. It folds flat for travel or tight spaces like dorms and apartments.

A collectible prize figure of Echidna from the Re:Zero franchise, shown in a Mandarin dress version. The figure comes with a base stand for display. It is an officially licensed product made by Taito.

A women's black down jacket from Columbia with 700 fill power goose down insulation and Omni-Heat thermal reflective lining. It is waterproof, breathable, and fully seam sealed, with a removable, adjustable storm hood, a zippered waist pocket, and an adjustable hem.

specs.material: Combed cotton with rubber anti-slip dots on sole

record.description: Non-slip crew socks for babies and toddlers, with varied rubber dots on the soles for grip while walking, crawling, or playing on slides. Made from combed cotton with medium thickness that breathes and stretches to fit easily inside shoes. The loose ankle elastic and smooth heel tabs add comfort for delicate skin.

specs.subject: Edward Hopper, People in the Sun

record.description: Unframed canvas wall art reproducing Edward Hopper's People in the Sun, printed in high definition with vivid colors on thick canvas. Suited to living rooms, bedrooms, offices and cafes, and a considered gift for friends or family.

A fitted men's dress shirt in solid grey poplin, designed to resist wrinkles and stay easy to care for. It has a point collar that works with or without a tie, adjustable two-position cuffs, and a chest pocket for everyday essentials.

specs.assembled dimensions: 39.5 in L x 17.56 in W x 14.4 in H
specs.handle: Extra-long pull handle that folds under

record.description: A red steel wagon with rubber tires for hauling children, gardening supplies, coolers, and other loads. Its long pull handle folds under the wagon for compact storage, and its controlled turning radius is meant to reduce tipping. Recommended for children about 18 months and older.

specs.strap option: Adjustable, converts between traditional and crisscross

record.description: A wirefree everyday bra offering full coverage with lightly lined cups and a smooth, silky feel under clothing. Adjustable back straps convert between traditional and crisscross styles, and the hook and eye closure allows a customized fit.

specs.material: Wheat straw fiber and food-grade PP

record.description: A set of four lightweight cereal bowls made from wheat straw fiber and food-grade PP plastic. Each bowl holds about 24 ounces and has smooth rounded edges and deep sides for cereal, salad, soup, or noodles. The bowls are dishwasher and microwave safe and are presented as free of BPA.

specs.food contact: Does not leave residue on cake

record.description: A dark blue cake topper with a large sparkly "ONE" design for a baby boy's first birthday. Made from cardboard with glitter paper, it arrives assembled and ready to place on a cake. Also works as a prop for cake smash photos.

Self-lubricating flanged sleeve bearing made of sintered bronze to the SAE 841 Oilite standard. Its copper-colored body resists wear and corrosion and suits general-purpose uses with moderate speeds and loads. Maintenance-free operation.

specs.media handling: Sheet feed, roll feed, input tray, automatic cutter
specs.mobile printing: Direct print from Android and Chrome OS apps; HP Smart app for iOS and Android

record.description: A compact wireless plotter aimed at architects, engineers, and builders who print large drawings in a home or small office. It handles sheets and rolls from 8.3 to 24 inches wide, includes an automatic cutter, and supports printing from mobile devices.

specs.features: 4-way stretch, expandable shoulders, reinforced snaps

record.description: A five-pack of sleeveless white bodysuits for babies sized 6 to 12 months. The soft, flexible fabric stretches in four directions to move with the baby, and expandable shoulders make dressing easier. Reinforced snaps are designed for durability.

A set of three stainless steel mixing bowls in 1.5, 3, and 5-quart sizes. The stackable bowls suit whisking, mixing, marinating, and serving, and they can go in the refrigerator or freezer. They are dishwasher safe and resist staining, odors, and rust.

A short summer dress with a flattering V neckline, butterfly sleeves, and a high-waisted A-line cut. Its all-over print suits casual everyday wear. The fabric has no stretch, so consult the size chart before ordering. Machine or hand washable.
A green cactus-patterned neck lanyard with a card holder for two ID cards. Made of soft polyester with printing on both sides and a metal clasp for keys. Suitable as a gift for friends and family.

Women's short-sleeve Halloween graphic tee featuring a playful letter print and a Sanderson Sisters design. Made from a soft, stretchy, breathable cotton blend with a relaxed fit and round neckline. Suited to casual wear in spring, fall, and winter, and pairs easily with jeans or leggings. The care note recommends normal-temperature water to help preserve the color and lettering.

specs.card slots: 9 credit card slots plus 1 photo slot

record.description: A compact bi-fold women's wallet in pink, made from cowhide leather with an embossed checkered pattern. It has a zipper coin pocket, a full-length bill compartment, and a removable card sleeve. The RFID-blocking lining is meant to guard cards against unauthorized wireless scans.

specs.protection: Guards against bugs, moths, dirt, mildew and odors

record.description: Eight roll-up storage bags for travel, with three large suitcase bags and five medium carry-on bags. Air is pushed out by rolling the bag up, so no vacuum is required. Designed to help pack more into a suitcase and to shield stored items from insects, dirt, mildew, and odors. Suited to coats, laundry, and soiled items.

A women's running shoe built for moderate mileage, with gel cushioning in the rear and forefoot to soften impact. The outsole is designed to hold up under high-impact wear. The sockliner can be taken out to make room for a medical orthotic.

specs.assembly: Easy to assemble; all hardware included

record.description: A three-cube storage organizer with an open back and a sturdy frame, finished on both front and back. It can be set up vertically or horizontally and works with 13-inch fabric storage bins. Hardware is included for assembly.

specs.material: Patent PU leather with polyester lining

record.description: A solid-color flap handbag with a shiny patent finish and a retro look that suits dresses, skirts and everyday outfits. It has a top handle, a detachable chain strap for shoulder or crossbody carry, and a zipper plus magnetic snap closure. Sized to hold a phone, wallet, sunglasses and makeup case.

specs.material: PC back panel with TPU bumper
specs.features: Wireless charging supported; precise cutouts for buttons and ports

record.description: A slim protective case designed for the iPhone XR. It has a matte PC back with a 3D floral pattern and a soft TPU bumper with molded sides to help guard against drops and bumps. Cutouts give access to buttons and ports, and the case supports wireless charging.

A black infant bodysuit with a retro 90s sitcom quote print, made from soft, pre-shrunk ring-spun cotton. It has a short sleeve design and a snap crotch for easy changes. Suitable as a playful gift for baby showers, birthdays, or holidays.
Women's western cowboy boot from Ariat in a brown floral colorway. Includes a Duratread outsole and is listed in US women's size 11 M, with a classic western cowboy boot design.

specs.material: Die-cast aluminum alloy with anodized, PTFE-coated finish

record.description: Automatic electric running boards that extend when the door opens and retract out of sight when it closes. Includes an integrated low-profile LED light. Corrosion-resistant aluminum finish with stainless steel pivot pins and self-lubricating bushings. Pinch-proof sensing and a 5-year limited warranty.

A slim box chain made from sterling silver and finished with rhodium plating to help it keep its shine and resist tarnish. Its lightweight, sturdy links sit comfortably at the collarbone for everyday wear. The lobster claw clasp adds secure closure, and the piece suits layering or pairing with a pendant.
A large green shark-shaped eraser meant for correcting big mistakes on schoolwork or office paper. Suitable for students and office use, and it also makes a fun back-to-school gift.

specs.fit: Stretch, sheath silhouette; runs slightly small

record.description: A short-sleeved midi dress with a navy striped pattern, suited to work, business, or church occasions. Its stretch fabric follows a curvy sheath shape, with a round neckline and a concealed back zipper. Choose a larger size if you fall between sizes.

Replacement faucet aerator from Delta, part RP18454, made to fit Neo Style lavatory faucets. It has a chrome finish and a flow rate of 2.2 gallons per minute. The aerator uses a 55/64 inch by 27 female thread connection.

A lightweight button-up shirt for spring and summer, made from a linen and cotton blend that aims to keep air moving for comfort. Its narrow collar and rolled sleeves suit both business casual and weekend wear. The cut is fitted at the shoulders and trim through the chest and torso.

specs.fit: Close to the body, fitted slim silhouette

record.description: A men's lightweight T-shirt from the Goodthreads Amazon brand, made of soft jersey slub cotton. It has a V-neckline, a pocket at the chest, and a close-to-body fit for a slim silhouette.

specs.product type: Ramp cleat non-slip rubber floor mat

record.description: A black rubber floor mat with a textured cleat surface to reduce slipping on ramps, walkways, entryways, and boat docks. Its light weight makes it easy to move and install, and it suits high-traffic commercial or residential floors.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, tumble dry low

record.description: A white cotton throw blanket with a diamond pattern and decorative fringe along the edges. Its vintage-inspired style suits rustic or distressed decor. Drape it over a couch or chair for added warmth, or use it as a picnic or camping blanket.

A heavyweight aluminum pan for baking classic angel food cakes. The metal is meant to spread heat gently and evenly, and the nonstick coating helps cakes release easily and makes cleanup simpler. Hand washing with mild detergent is recommended.

specs.construction: Hard plastic back with flexible silicone bumper

record.description: A clear protective case for the iPhone 11 Pro Max with a slim profile that keeps the phone's original look visible. Hard back panel pairs with a soft bumper for grip, and corners are designed to absorb drops. Works with most wireless chargers.

specs.outsole: Direct injected one-component PU with shock point

record.description: Men's oxford shoe in black with a bike-toe profile, blind-eyelet lacing, and double-stitched seams. A moisture-wicking lining and a ventilation system aim to keep feet comfortable, while the PU outsole adds cushioning.

specs.included: 4-inch and 12-inch extensions, 4 spindle rods, 4 wall cups

record.description: A pressure-mounted steel safety gate with a walk-through door for doorways, hallways, and stair bottoms. It expands to fit openings of roughly 29 to 47 inches and includes extension pieces, mounting rods, and wall cups for added security. Suited to children around 6 to 24 months and wipes clean.

Men's low-cut soccer shoe from adidas built for artificial turf play. Offers a regular fit and a 3D-printed strike zone pattern called Demonscale for striking the ball. Finished in core black with white and red accents, size 11.5.

specs.included: 3 rope pieces (5 ft each), stainless steel D-rings, hardware kit

record.description: A triangular sun shade sail for patios, gardens, pools, and lawns. Made from HDPE that blocks up to 95% of UV rays while letting air and water pass through. Includes ropes and D-rings for installation at a sloped angle.

specs.fit: High waisted flare palazzo wide leg
specs.care: Hand wash cold, do not bleach, hang dry

record.description: Flowy high-waisted flare palazzo pants with a wide leg and soft peachskin fabric. The higher waistband is designed to sit comfortably and help prevent sagging. Available in regular and plus sizes, in a printed or solid style.

specs.care: Machine wash cold on gentle; tumble dry low or sun-dry

record.description: A reversible queen comforter set with two matching pillow shams. The brushed microfiber shell and polyester fill offer a soft, lightweight feel with warmth for use in any season. Two solid colors let you change the look of the bed. Machine washable in cold water.

specs.light source: CREE XM-L T6 LED, max 800 lumens

record.description: A bright, zoomable LED headlamp with three lighting modes and an adjustable elastic headband. The head pivots up to 90 degrees for directed light. Its IP50 rating suits outdoor use, though the battery cover is not waterproof and it should not be submerged.

Keto-friendly snack wafers from Atkins in a lemon vanilla flavor. Each box holds five crisps with a vanilla-coated wafer shell around a lemon filling. The listing says each crisp offers 11 grams of protein and 5 grams of fiber, with 4 grams of net carbs and 1 gram of sugar per serving, suited to a low-carb lifestyle.

specs.feature: Flame resistant, NFPA 70E, NFPA 2112, CAT 2 rated

record.description: Women's mid rise bootcut jeans with an entwined pattern and stretchable cotton-Lycra blend for comfortable all-day wear. Flame resistant and rated to NFPA 70E, NFPA 2112, and CAT 2 for hazardous work settings. Embroidered back pocket detail adds a finished look.

specs.material: Wool-like plush fleece lining, plush upper

record.description: Slip-on women's house slippers with a soft fleece lining and a grey wool-like plush upper. A high-density memory foam insole cushions and supports the feet, while the rubber sole offers traction for indoor and outdoor wear. Machine washable for easy care.

Relaxed straight-fit carpenter jeans in lightweight, garment-washed cotton duck. Features deep front and back pockets, a utility pocket, a hammer loop, and triple-stitched seams for durability. Roomy through the seat and legs for bending and kneeling, with a straight leg that fits over boots.

A matching his-and-hers wedding and engagement ring set in polished stainless steel. The women's ring has a prong-set round cubic zirconia center stone, and the men's band is a comfort-fit design. Both rings arrive in a gift box, suited to anniversaries, birthdays, and other special occasions.

specs.compatibility: Binoculars without a threaded tripod socket

record.description: A universal mount that lets binoculars without a built-in threaded tripod socket be used with a tripod. It uses a common 1/4-inch-20 screw thread and is designed to fit a wide range of binocular models.

specs.type: Spa thong slipper (flip flop style, open toe)

record.description: Women's house slipper in a classic flip flop design with a soft terry upper and a memory foam footbed for heel and arch support. The rubber sole is skid-resistant and lightweight, suited to indoor and outdoor use. Machine washable.

specs.size: M/L, fits US women's shoe size 8-11
specs.features: Graduated compression, arch support, seamless toe closure, non-cushion

record.description: Women's graduated compression socks suited to everyday wear, travel, long periods of sitting or standing, and exercise. Moderate compression with four zones aims to support circulation and ease leg fatigue. Made from moisture-managing yarns.

A relaxed women's tunic top with a floral print, 3/4 sleeves that roll up with tabs, and a notched V-neck. The high-low hem flares gently at the front. Made from a soft, lightweight, stretchy poly-spandex blend, it pairs well with leggings, jeans, or pants.

Black Samsonite luggage strap that makes your suitcase easier to identify among others. Its rugged ABS buckle is built to handle baggage handling, and the polypropylene strap adjusts to fit bags up to 72 inches. No lock is included.

A classic Western-style ankle bootie with a V cutout at the front and a low stacked block heel. Its inner zip makes it easy to slip on and off, and a lightly padded footbed supports comfortable everyday walking. Made from man-made materials.

A set of 69 PVC vinyl stickers themed on the Futurama animated TV series. Suited for decorating laptops, backpacks, skateboards, bicycles, luggage, and other surfaces. Sized roughly one to three inches each, for children, teens, and adults alike.

Women's strappy sandals from Crocs with a cushioned LiteRide foam insole and a Croslite foam outsole. The soft, flexible gore uppers are designed for a relaxed fit, and the shoe is built for everyday comfort. Sizing note: a size up is suggested.

specs.paper: High quality paper stock from well-managed forests

record.description: A funny Hallmark Shoebox birthday card for a friend or relative, with modern lettering on a sunrise background and an irreverent, laugh-out-loud message inside. Comes with a matching envelope.

Slip-on flats for women with a knit upper, cotton lining, and a removable leather insole that adds arch and heel cushioning. The jelly outsole is designed to resist slipping. Machine washable once the insole is taken out. Sized in European numbers, and the listing advises sizing up.
A lightweight graphic t-shirt with a Switzerland and Swiss Alps theme, suited to hiking, travel, or as a gift. It has a classic fit and double-needle stitching at the sleeves and hem.

specs.application: Heating and AC ducts and pipes
specs.installation: No gloves, face mask, or goggles needed

record.description: Foil-backed cotton wrap for insulating, cushioning, and damping vibration on heating and air conditioning ducts and pipes. It carries a Class A fire rating and installs without gloves, a face mask, or goggles.

Espresso and cappuccino machine with a brushed stainless-steel finish and red accents. It uses a 20 bar pump and up to 1,350 watts to brew ground coffee or pods, and its steam nozzle froths milk for cappuccinos and other hot drinks. A removable drip tray and detachable water tank make cleanup and refilling easier.

A 20-inch freestyle BMX bike from Dynacraft in the Air Zone Badlands line. It includes a freestyle rotor, front and rear U-brakes, and pegs at both ends. The 48-spoke wheels and deluxe paint finish complete the design.

specs.material: High density fiberboard and solid wood veneer

record.description: A walnut jewelry armoire with a lockable top lid, side doors fitted with double-tiered necklace hooks, and eight pull-out drawers for storing rings and other pieces. The lid opens to ring rolls, a divided compartment, and a vanity mirror. Ships ready to use with no assembly needed.

specs.included: carry bag, repair kit, 5 stakes, 2 hoses

record.description: An inflatable water park for children with two slides, a climbing wall, a splash pool and a water cannon. Made from puncture-resistant PVC-coated oxford fabric with safety netting, it suits kids roughly three to ten years old. It inflates in minutes, folds for storage, and the blower is sold separately.

A wired optical computer mouse with three buttons and a rubber scroll wheel for everyday office and home computing. It offers 1000 DPI tracking, a plug-and-play USB connection requiring no drivers, and a rainbow LED light. Compatible with Windows, macOS, laptops, desktops, and notebooks.

specs.sole: Vulcanized rubber with 2.5mm bonded felt frost plug

record.description: A mid-calf winter boot from Sorel with waterproof suede leather uppers and a soft shearling cuff. The faux fur lining adds warmth, and the vulcanized rubber shell with herringbone outsole helps handle wet, snowy conditions. A bonded felt frost plug sits in the midsole.

Individual faux mink eyelash extensions for salon use, in CC curl and 0.25 mm thickness. Offered in lengths from 8 mm to 20 mm. The metallic film strips are designed to leave no paper-backing residue, aiming for quicker application and longer wear.

A men's long sleeve T-shirt from Gildan in a two-pack, sized Medium. The stay-cool fabric is designed to wick moisture away, and the cuffs include spandex for stretch and recovery. Neck tape adds reinforcement, and the side seams are built to stay straight after washing.

A minimizer underwire bra designed to smooth and shape while reducing the appearance of bust projection. Features wider-set straps and a more open underwire for comfortable support, plus an open neckline with balanced coverage.

A folding wedge-shaped gymnastics mat with a 15.5-degree incline for tumbling, stretching, yoga, and general exercise. Its trapezoidal shape lets several mats stack for storage. The removable zippered cover allows the inner pad to be taken out and the outer casing cleaned.

specs.wearing options: Arms in, arms out, or one arm of each

record.description: A large swaddle wearable blanket for infants about 0-3 months old, sized for babies weighing 7 to 14 pounds or up to 26 inches long. It can be worn with arms in, arms out, or one arm of each, and a bottom zipper allows diaper changes without unwrapping the baby. Adjustable hook-and-loop wings help create a snug fit.

A small 14k white gold pendant charm shaped as the number 1, laser cut and finished with a brushed texture. Suitable for wearing on a necklace, it measures about 14.32 mm long and 3.81 mm wide and is sold individually.

A slim, clear protective case for iPhone X and XS with D3O impact material to help absorb knocks and drops. Bevelled edges add protection, and precision cut-outs give access to buttons and ports. Its UV-coated surface resists scratches while keeping the phone visible.

Winter ankle boots for women with a warm lined interior, padded collar, and faux fur trim at the ankle. Made from vegan faux leather with quilted side panels, and a rubber sole designed for steady footing on slippery surfaces.

Men's classic five-pocket jeans with a slim fit through the thigh that widens to a bootcut leg. Sits below the waist, with a little stretch built in to aid comfort and help the jeans keep their shape for everyday wear.

specs.dial: Round white dial with Indiglo light

record.description: A women's wristwatch from Timex with a round white dial, full Arabic numerals, and a 24-hour military time display. The reversible nylon slip-thru strap shows a blue side and a floral-and-swirl side. It has a silver-tone 38mm case and an Indiglo backlight. Water resistant to 30 meters for splashes only, not swimming.

Women's cargo-style scrub pants with a low rise and drawstring waistband for an adjustable fit. Several pockets, including one sized for scissors, and a D-ring on the left leg. Adjustable toggles at the ankles complete the design.

specs.care: Hand/cold wash separately, hang to dry, avoid sun exposure

record.description: A one-piece swimsuit for little girls with a playful printed pattern. Made from a smooth, stretchy polyamide and elastane blend that dries fairly quickly and allows free movement. Suited to pool parties, beach days, bath time, and photo sessions.

specs.features: Lightweight, double-needle sleeve and bottom hem

record.description: A lightweight classic-fit t-shirt with a Miles Morales Spider-Verse design. Officially licensed Marvel apparel, with double-needle stitching along the sleeves and bottom hem.

specs.washability: Washes out with ordinary shampoo and water
specs.hair type note: Best on light hair such as gray and blond; dark hair may need water first

record.description: A set of ten bright temporary hair chalks paired with a comb for quick, non-permanent color changes. The chalks can be used alone or blended together and rinse out with regular shampoo. Suited to dress-up, parties, cosplay, and gifts for children.

Women's no-show liner socks in black, sold as a three-pair pack. Features a breathable mesh top, a cushioned ventilated sole, and a silicone heel grip to help keep them in place. Made with a super soft construction for everyday comfort inside low-cut shoes.

A 5.2-channel home theater receiver that handles 4K Ultra HD video with HDR and HLG support. Built-in Bluetooth and a USB port let you play music from phones and other devices, and HEOS Link adds wireless streaming and multi-room audio. An on-screen setup guide helps with connections and surround tuning.

specs.material: High-density egg crate acoustic foam with hardwood panels

record.description: A foldable vocal booth designed to tame room echo and reflections for voice and instrument recording. Its interior is lined with dense egg crate foam, and it includes openings for cables and a mic stand. It sets up for tabletop or stand use and folds flat for travel.

specs.material: 100% cotton washed canvas front, 100% polyester mesh back
specs.sweatband: Carhartt Force sweatband with odor control and FastDry

record.description: A structured, medium-profile cap from Carhartt with a cotton canvas front and breathable polyester mesh back. It has a pre-curved sandwich visor, a Carhartt patch on the front, and a sweatband meant to resist odor and wick moisture.

specs.operating system: Android TV with built-in Google Assistant voice search
specs.audio: Internal bass-reflex speaker; 3.5mm stereo output with preset tone controls

record.description: A compact laser projector that casts bright, colorful images up to 150 inches, even in a lit room. It includes Android TV with a remote, voice search, and access to popular streaming apps. An internal speaker and a 3.5mm audio output provide sound options. Its clean, modern look suits most décors.

Retro tennis-style women's sneaker from Nike with a leather upper and traditional lacing for a secure fit. The solid rubber outsole has a herringbone pattern for traction, and a soft fabric lining with a comfort footbed supports all-day wear.

specs.features: Detachable hand strap

record.description: A black travel organizer for keeping chargers, cables, memory cards, and small gadgets in one place. Elastic loops and mesh pockets hold items in position, and a padded section protects a mini tablet or e-reader. Its water-resistant nylon shell and two zippers make it easy to open and carry.

specs.water resistance: Highly water-resistant with UA Storm finish

record.description: A roomy women's tote from Under Armour with a highly water-resistant finish for wet-weather use. It has a large main compartment, an oversized wordmark zipper pull, and double webbing straps for carrying in more than one way. Holds about 25 liters.

specs.model: Nike Air Zoom Mariah Flyknit Racer

record.description: Nike's modernized take on the Air Mariah, a shoe first released in the 1980s. This version has a sock-like Flyknit upper, Zoom Air cushioning, a heel pull tab, and a durable rubber outsole, all built for a lightweight feel.

specs.included: Hook & loop roll, push pins, instruction manual

record.description: A magnetic screen door curtain that lets fresh air and sunlight into a home while keeping insects out. Made from fiberglass mesh with reinforced webbing on all four sides, and stitched at the top middle for added durability. Hook and loop fasteners in the middle and bottom help hold it in place in windy conditions.

A large shaggy area rug in teal blue with a soft, thick pile that feels plush underfoot. Anti-slip dots on the underside help keep it in place on smooth floors. A middle sponge layer adds cushioning and helps dampen noise. Suited to living rooms, bedrooms, and kids' rooms. Keep the underside dry to prevent slipping.

A long sleeve henley-style popover shirt for men with a mandarin collar, chest buttons, and a straight cut at the waist. Made from a cotton-poly oxford blend that is slightly thick, so it is not see-through. Suits spring, summer evenings, and fall, and works for costumes or everyday wear.

specs.putting surface: approx. 2 ft x 8.5 ft inside border
specs.included: 2 putting holes with flags

record.description: A large practice putting mat with realistic turf designed to feel and roll like a real green. It includes two holes with flags and a padded rubber base for comfort. Suitable for indoor or outdoor use, it gives golfers a convenient way to sharpen their putting at home.

A manual-focus prime lens for APS-C mirrorless cameras with a fast F1.2 maximum aperture, suited to low-light shooting and blurred backgrounds. It fits Canon EOS-M mount bodies and has a crescent-shaped focus ring and a compact metal build.

specs.included: 2 candles, 1 remote control, 1 user manual
specs.features: Waterproof, flickering moving flame, remote, timers 2H/4H/6H/8H

record.description: A pair of battery-operated flameless candles with a flickering moving flame. The frosted plastic shells are designed to be used indoors or outdoors and resist water. A remote control adjusts flicker or steady glow and brightness, and timers switch the candles on at the same time each day.

specs.included items: Long sleeve shirt or long johns

record.description: Men's thermal base layer set for autumn and winter use, offered as a long sleeve shirt or long johns. Designed for activities such as hiking, cycling, skiing, and training, it uses three-dimensional elastic zones for freedom of movement and moisture management.

A replacement USB charging cable for the Mini S530 Bluetooth headphones. It has a 2.0mm by 12.0mm DC tip and a 30cm cable, and can plug into wall adapters, laptop USB ports, power banks, or car chargers. Measure your device's charging port before ordering, since it is not compatible with every model.

specs.feature: Front tab for pulling the box out
specs.decoration: 100% polyester felt dog appliqué on front

record.description: Fabric storage box designed for children's rooms and nurseries. Its square 13-inch frame is sized to fit most cube shelving units, and a front tab lets kids and adults pull it out easily. A felt dog animal shape on the front adds a playful touch.

specs.dimensions: 9.5 x 8.0 x 10.5 inches (expanded 11 x 8.0 x 10.5 inches)
specs.included: 1 lunch bag

record.description: A grey insulated lunch bag with a double-layer design so foods can be kept separate and not squashed. The smooth, wipeable PEVA liner resists leaks and cleans easily. Suited to lunches, picnics, beach trips, and everyday carrying, and ice cubes can help keep contents cold for hours.

A set of four stoneware rice bowls from Denby's Heritage Terrace line. Each bowl is handcrafted by skilled artisans and suits oven, microwave, and freezer use, and the set is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning.

specs.features: Corrugate block and floor scratcher with lounging chaise shape

A cherry blossom scented body cleanser that washes gently and leaves skin lightly perfumed. Work it into a lather on wet skin, then rinse for a floral shower. Suited to sensitive skin.

A lace-up boat shoe that works as both a casual sneaker and a dressier shoe for kids. It has a leather-like upper, a cushioned memory foam footbed, and a rubber outsole for traction.

A three-tier corner wall shelf made from lightweight paulownia wood with a torched dark brown finish. Hangs from a nail, screw, or hook with an adjustable jute rope. Designed for corners only, it suits displaying small décor, photos, and plants in living spaces, bedrooms, or bathrooms.
A soft cotton dress set for baby girls, featuring a blueberry print. The coordinating dresses are made from 100% cotton and suited to everyday wear, with a gentle feel against delicate skin.

specs.features: Odor control, rapid-drying top, Wet-Lock gel, attractant

specs.open size: 18 in H x 3 in W x 15 in D

specs.lettering: Black OVERSIZE LOAD, 2 in x 12 in letters

A set of 48 neon green floating golf balls for practice in water, such as pools, ponds, or water ranges. Each two-piece ball has 432 dimples and a molded Surlyn cover. Includes a carry bag for transport and storage.

specs.connection: Universal faucet adapter with quick connect

specs.installation: By yourself in a few seconds

Made of brass with a polished finish, it attaches to most round faucets and aims to reduce splashing.

specs.midsole: Bounce midsole with Boost in the heel
specs.recycled content: Upper contains a minimum of 50% recycled content

record.description: Men's golf shoes from adidas in a grey, green and black colorway. Regular fit with lace closure. The mesh and synthetic upper includes recycled materials, and Bounce and Boost cushioning support the midsole.
A men's straw hat in an Outback-style silhouette, finished in a natural tone. The crown is vented for airflow, making it a practical choice for warm-weather outings.

A two-piece clear canister set with one 15 oz and one 20 oz jar, suited to holding cotton swabs, cotton balls, cotton rounds, and bath salts. Each jar has a wide mouth and a removable lid. The plastic resembles glass while being shatter-resistant.

specs.use: Face: upper and lower lips, cheeks, chin

A hooded reindeer costume for dogs in a Medium size, suited to Christmas celebrations or any winter-themed party. It closes with Velcro at the neck and chest. The listing gives two different measurement sets, so compare the size details against your dog before buying.

A height-adjustable standing desk with a 47 by 30 inch wooden top on a metal frame. Dual motors raise and lower it between 29 and 49 inches, and the top tilts from 13 to 45 degrees. A touch control panel includes memory presets, a child lock, and two USB charging ports.

specs.contents: 5 pirates, 2-piece cannon, treasure chest, eye patch, flag

record.description: A ten-piece set of hand-painted pirate figures for imaginative play, with five pirates, a two-piece cannon, a treasure chest, an eye patch, and an X-marks-the-spot flag. Suited to pretend play, school projects, dioramas, and party decorations for children ages 3 and up.

specs.cushioning: Gel pads in heel and forefoot

specs.style: Mid-century modern accent arm lounge chair

A two-tier round lunch container made of stainless steel with a white twist-open design. Locking clips hold the tiers together, and the vacuum-tight seal is meant to limit leaks and spills. Suitable for soup and other hot food, and safe to wash in the dishwasher or store in the freezer.

Women's printed knit Bermuda pajama shorts with an elastic waistband and relaxed fit. The chambray blue colorway features a hand-drawn print from HUE's New York design studio, made for comfortable sleepwear.

specs.other parts: Optional head, backpack for wings, Tamashii Stage joint parts

Red mesh-pattern decal designed to be applied to the radiator grille of a 2018 Kia Stinger for a sporty look. Attaches with included adhesive double-sided tape and is sold as one set.
A stylized vinyl collectible figure of Thor from the Avengers Endgame film, made by Funko in its Pop! line. Standing about 3.75 inches tall, it suits display alongside other Avengers Endgame figures.

specs.fit: Standard US sizing, for adults and kids

A 9-foot round patio umbrella with a beige polyester canopy that shades a table for four to six people. It opens with a hand crank, tilts with a push button, and has a vent to ease airflow. The base is sold separately.

specs.kit_contents: Tin planter, plant liner, 2 pucks, brush, paint strip, 3 seed packets

Men's hiking shoe from Merrell with a suede leather and mesh upper for trail use. Breathable mesh lining and a bellows tongue help keep out moisture and debris. Features a Vibram TC5-plus outsole with 5mm lugs and a protective rubber toe cap. Walnut colorway, size 10.5 M US.

specs.handle: Retractable telescoping trolley handle, extends 41 inches

Grab handles on the top, bottom, and sides make lifting easy.

specs.care: Hand wash cold, do not bleach, hang or line dry

specs.warranty: One year free warranty; 30-day satisfaction guarantee

Metal aviator sunglasses for women from Jessica Simpson, with gold-tone frames, adjustable nose pads, and gradient brown-tinted polycarbonate lenses with a UV-protective coating. Includes a soft microfiber pouch for storage and lens cleaning.

A men's heavyweight car coat in black, made from a thick, warm wool-blend twill with a soft, cozy feel. It has a button-front closure and a roomy cut through the chest and waist for comfortable layering.

specs.formula: Ammonia free, paraben free, gluten free, vegan

A mid-height women's ankle boot from Timberland's White Ledge line, made for hiking and outdoor wear. It has leather uppers, shock-absorbing cushioning, and rubber lug outsoles for traction on varied terrain.

Men's cap from Under Armour in Academy Blue with red accents. Features a pre-curved visor and structured front panels for a low-profile fit, with foam padding at the front for comfort. Fabric uses quick-drying Microthread technology.

A handmade flower crown headband in royal blue, designed to be worn as a hair wreath. It suits brides, bridesmaids, and flower girls at weddings, festivals, and photo shoots, with an elegant floral look.

An oversized, floppy-brimmed bonnet built for costume wear, giving an easy touch of classic American style. One size fits most teens and adults. The listed color is white, and the product is also offered in red and black.

Men's Stance Chewbacca piece in green, sized Large. Features a seamless toe closure for a smooth fit, built-in arch support, and reinforced heel and toe areas for added durability.

Crafted from stone resin and hand-painted, it shows intricate detail and the folk-art style of traditional American and European designs. Comes in an individual box, suited to display on a shelf or desk.

Wired craft ribbon with a traditional woven plaid pattern in warm orange and green, with metallic accents. The monofilament wire along the edges helps shape loops and bows that hold their form. Suited to fall and Thanksgiving decor, floral arrangements, wreaths, table runners, and gift packaging.

specs.closure: Button down front, cuffs, and collar

record.description: A men's plaid long-sleeve button-down shirt in a classic cut with extra room through the shoulders, chest, and body. Features extra-long sleeves and tails, a single open front pocket, and buttons at the front, cuffs, and collar.

A five-string bass guitar from Ibanez with a brown finish, built for right-handed players. It has a maple neck, a spalted maple top over a mahogany body, and a rosewood fretboard with white dot inlays. It also features medium frets and a B15 bridge.

A daily body wash enriched with oat that cleanses away dirt, oil and bacteria while helping skin feel moisturized. Designed for dry, itchy or sensitive skin, it is soap-free, dye-free and fragrance-free, and suitable for everyday use.

specs.fit: Loose fit with non-slip bee grip footies

record.description: A one-piece footed romper for baby girls, made from breathable organic cotton suited to sensitive skin. The diagonal zip front makes diaper changes easier, and a loose cut with a large gusset allows room to move from playtime to bedtime. Non-slip grips on the feet add stability.

A compact USB-C wall charger delivering up to 18W via USB Power Delivery 3.0 for iPhones, iPads, and other USB-C devices. Its foldable plug and slim profile make it easy to carry for home, office, or travel. Built-in safeguards guard against excess current, overheating, and overcharging.

specs.design: Sculpted double heart with rhinestone accents

record.description: A set of three nickel-plated candle stands with sculpted double heart designs and rhinestone accents. The large stand holds a 3-inch pillar candle, and the two taper stands suit wedding unity candle displays or romantic decor.

Men's slip-on driving loafer from Lacoste in black leather. Features a flexible moccasin construction, an embossed crocodile logo, and a cushioned foam insole for everyday comfort and shock absorption.

specs.material: Steel pipe frame, sponge fill, solid wood legs, linen fabric
specs.backrest: Adjustable from 90 to 180 degrees, five angles

record.description: A two-seat convertible loveseat with foldable armrests that open into a sleeper bed. The backrest reclines through five angles, and the removable linen cover can be taken off for cleaning. Solid wood legs and a hardwood-framed interior suit apartments, studios, and small living rooms.

A men's graphic t-shirt featuring a geisha and flower garden design in burgundy. Made from 100% cotton with a soft wash finish, it is machine washable and has a tagless neck label for everyday comfort.

specs.includes: Full bodysuit, wings, gloves, and hat
specs.features: Glitter accents, elastic arm cuffs, padded waist, knees, and leg cuffs

record.description: A Buzz Lightyear costume for toddlers, designed for Halloween dress-up. The set includes a full bodysuit, detachable soft fabric wings, gloves, and a hat. Glitter accents and padded areas add detail, and self-stick fabric at the back makes it easy to put on and take off.

Reusable stainless steel bombilla straws for drinking yerba mate, tea, and other beverages. The flared filter end has small holes that let liquid through while holding back loose leaves. A spoon-shaped tip helps scoop out spent mate. Set of three, sized for shorter gourds and mugs, and small enough to carry in a pocket or backpack.

specs.subjects: Reading, writing, math, science, social studies
specs.included extras: Stickers, flash cards, award certificate, answer key
specs.dimensions: 0.44 in H x 8.38 in W x 10.88 in L

record.description: A summer workbook that helps children moving from fourth to fifth grade keep their skills sharp. Short daily activities cover language arts, math, and science, with fitness, outdoor, and experiment extras. Stickers, flash cards, and an answer key are included.

specs.uses: Indoor plant pots and general storage

record.description: A set of two hand-woven cotton rope baskets in 12 and 10 inch sizes. They work as indoor plant covers and as storage for items such as toys, towels, and craft supplies. Their natural, minimal look suits a range of home decor styles.

Men's analog-quartz dress watch from Bulova with a tonneau-shaped case and curved mineral crystal. The stainless steel case sits on a black leather strap with an alligator-style finish. Measuring 44.5 mm across, it is splash resistant to 30 meters but should not be worn for swimming or bathing.

specs.features: Waterproof, stain resistant

record.description: A neoprene retainer strap that keeps sunglasses secured during outdoor activities and water sports. It attaches to the arms of most frame styles and can be worn or hung around the neck. Its floating design keeps lightweight glasses afloat, though testing the weight limit first is advised. Water and stain resistant, it suits salt or fresh water.

specs.features: Built-in handles, open tops, stackable
specs.care: Hand wash with soap and water; not dishwasher safe

record.description: A set of four clear plastic bins with built-in handles for keeping desk and office supplies in order. The open tops and see-through walls make it easy to spot items like pens, notes, and small electronics. They suit desk drawers, shelves, filing cabinets, and closets, and the stackable design fits small spaces.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, no bleach

record.description: Two decorative chenille-blend cushion covers in a cream and black mixed pattern. Soft, textured plush fabric suits sofas, beds, chairs and floors. Invisible zippers make inserting and removing pillows easy. Covers are sold without pillow inserts and are designed for 20 x 20 inch pillows.

specs.filling: All-natural grain and dried French lavender
specs.safety: Meets U.S. safety standards for all ages

record.description: A 20-inch plush soft toy that can be warmed in the microwave for cozy comfort. Filled with natural grain and dried French lavender, it offers gentle warmth and a soothing lavender scent. Made from soft fabric, it suits a bedtime companion or an on-the-go snuggle buddy. Sold as a single piece.

specs.block_size: 6 in L x 6 in W x 6 in H
specs.certifications: GREENGUARD Gold, CPSIA, CA-117, ASTM F963, CertiPUR foam
specs.care: Wipe clean with mild soap and water or bleach-free wipe

record.description: A 12-piece set of soft foam blocks designed for toddlers to stack, build, and explore. Bright primary colors help little ones learn color recognition while developing motor skills, coordination, and imagination. Blocks can be wiped clean.

specs.dimensions: 18 in H x 13 in W x 9 in D

record.description: A lightweight, water-repellent backpack from Vera Bradley built for travel, hiking, camping, and everyday use. It has a padded laptop compartment, several exterior and interior pockets, a trolley sleeve for rolling luggage, and an adjustable chest strap for comfort.

A slim, lightweight protective case built for the iPhone 11 Pro Max, not the standard iPhone 11 or 11 Pro. Its soft flexible TPU shell has a matte surface that feels smooth and grippy, and raised edges help guard the phone while keeping its original shape. Cutouts line up with the buttons, camera, flash, speakers, and charging port.

A lightweight long-sleeve crewneck sweater for women with a classic, close-but-comfortable fit that allows easy movement. Soft yarn and ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem give it a neat finish for everyday wear.

specs.dietary: GMO free, soy free, gluten free

record.description: A 60-capsule iodine supplement made from dried sea kelp grown in the United States. Each capsule provides 250 mcg of iodine, a trace mineral the body needs. The vegetarian capsules are free of soy, gluten, GMOs, and added preservatives. A bottle offers about a two-month supply.

specs.dimensions: 20 x 14 x 7 inches (50 x 35 x 18 cm)

record.description: A black 40-liter carry-on backpack made from water-resistant polyester. It expands for extra packing room, opens fully through a 180-degree zipper, and has padded handles, hideaway shoulder straps, and a laptop compartment for up to 17.3 inches. An anti-theft back pocket holds valuables.

Mars Black acrylic paint in a 75 ml tube. The opaque, vibrant color blends smoothly and dries to a waterproof finish. Tubes can be pegged for upright storage. Labeled as meeting ASTM D 4236 non-toxic standards.
A long striped Santa hat in bold red and white for holiday dress-up. It has a faux fur trim and a pom-pom on top, and is made from soft felt and faux fur for comfortable all-day wear.

specs.closure type: Checked upright with retractable trolley handle

record.description: A checked upright suitcase with an ABS shell that expands by an additional two inches when more room is needed. Eight multi-directional spinner wheels aim to make moving it easier, and the interior offers zippered pockets, elastic shoe pockets, and a garment restraint panel. Corner guards help protect the exterior.

A two-pack of men's short sleeve T-shirts in white, sized extra large. Each shirt has a left chest pocket with a small exterior logo, a tagless back neck label, and taped neck and shoulder seams for durability.

specs.included: 1 dressing stool, 1 accessories kit

record.description: A classic European-style vanity stool with a padded seat, carved solid wood legs, and a sturdy MDF frame. It suits a dressing table and also works as a dining, lounge, piano, or shoe stool.

A navy kitchen island with a sturdy butcher block top suited to food prep or extra serving space. Two smooth-gliding drawers and three cabinets offer room for kitchen storage. Included casters let you roll it around, or swap in the feet to keep it fixed in place.

A set of 60 permanent markers in assorted bright colors with fine tips. The quick-drying ink is designed to be waterproof, smear-proof, and fade-resistant on paper, plastic, wood, metal, and glass. Suited to doodling, coloring, and marking projects.

Men's Superstar sneakers from Golden Goose with a mix of textures: a grey suede-look upper, smooth blue leather heel tab and star detail, and a vintage-inspired finish. Lightweight and breathable, with a rubber sole and a casual look that pairs easily with everyday outfits.

A slip-on men's sneaker from Quiksilver in grey with a no-sew mesh upper. Its welded construction includes molded structural underlays designed to give a performance-oriented fit. Available in US men's size 13 (46).

A marine digital media receiver from Sony with built-in Bluetooth, a front USB port for iOS and media devices, and playback of common audio file formats. The IPx5 water-resistant design suits boat use, and it is ready for SiriusXM satellite radio.

A bare-board switching power supply module that converts 100-240V AC input to a 24V DC output rated around 150W. Its double-sided PCB design aims for stable operation, and it includes over-voltage, over-current, and short-circuit protection. Intended for industrial control systems.

A machine-woven area rug with a modern Moroccan ombre pattern in silver and black. Its synthetic fibers resist stains and the low pile sheds very little. Suited to busy rooms such as living rooms, bedrooms, and home offices. Vacuum regularly and blot minor spills with mild detergent or carpet cleaner.

A soft faux fur throw in black with a plush front and fluffy sherpa back. Made from microfiber, it can drape over a couch or chair or be tucked between a comforter and sheet on a bed. The fabric is skin-friendly and resists fading and staining better than cotton.
A women's slide sandal from Ted Baker's Avelini collection in a bright yellow shade. Offered in US size 8.5 Regular, this slide style is a simple option for casual wear.

A decorative 16x16 throw pillow printed on both sides with a campfire scene and white lettering that jokes camping without beer is just sitting in the woods. Its spun-polyester cover is filled with polyester and sewn shut, making it a playful gift for campers who enjoy good company around the fire.

specs.wordmark: Large adidas wordmark knit on outside of foot

record.description: A six-pair pack of men's no-show socks from adidas in a black colorway with Onix marl accents. The lightweight Superlite build is designed for a low profile, and moisture-wicking yarn helps keep feet dry from sweat. Sized large for shoe sizes 6 to 12.

Minimalist black ballet flats with a round toe and elastic ankle strap. Faux suede uppers feel soft, and a heel zipper makes them easy to slip on and off. Cushioned, contoured soles and a flexible build suit everyday walking, errands, and casual or semi-formal outfits.

specs.mounting: Black hook pre-mounted, ready to hang

record.description: Framed floral wall art printed on waterproof canvas with a gray and yellow blossom design. Stretched over a pine frame and ready to hang with a pre-attached hook. Suitable for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, offices, and other indoor spaces.

A full figure underwire bra in ivory from Wacoal's Retro Chic line. Two-part seamed cups aim to offer lift, shape, and support, with a sheer mesh panel at the top of each cup. The band and sides are designed to lie smooth and reduce bulge.

Individual eyelash extensions in a hybrid silk mink blend, offered in several L-series curls and thicknesses for building lash sets. Available in mixed or single lengths from 8 to 15mm. The lashes are designed to lift cleanly from the strip with little residue and no kinks.

specs.included: Removable activity bar and canopy

record.description: A lightweight infant lounger that folds into a backpack with a single motion. Includes a removable activity bar and canopy, a waterproof base, and a machine-washable cover. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use in a natural colorway.

specs.construction: Triple layer: hard outer shell with soft silicone inner skin
specs.protection: Shockproof, raised bezel for screen and camera
specs.port access: Bottom cutouts with attached dust caps

record.description: A slim protective case for Apple iPod Touch 5th, 6th, and 7th generation models. It pairs a hard outer shell with a soft silicone inner layer to absorb shocks from small drops. A raised front edge helps shield the screen and camera, while bottom cutouts keep buttons and ports accessible.

specs.care: Hand wash with mild soap and water; not dishwasher safe

record.description: A refillable pump dispenser for liquid soap, dish soap, or hand sanitizer at bathroom vanities, sinks, or kitchen counters. Its compact round frosted body suits small pedestal sinks, and the removable pump head and wide opening make refilling simple. Made from plastic that resists rust.

specs.coverage: Up to 500 sq. ft. per kit, depending on surface porosity
specs.cure time: Walk on in 8-10 hours; vehicle ready in 24 hours

record.description: A self-leveling concrete floor coating for interior surfaces such as garage floors, workshops, and basements. Its buildable polycuramine formula dries to a glossy terrazzo-style finish that resists cracking, peeling, chemical spills, and hot tire pickup. Packaged in a six-piece kit.

specs.battery life: About a month or more between charges
specs.surface: Edge-to-edge glass, nearly 30% larger than previous trackpad
specs.touch technology: Force Touch with four force sensors

record.description: A wireless trackpad for desktop use with a rechargeable built-in battery. Force Touch sensors let you click anywhere on the glass surface and sense differences in pressure. The large, low-profile surface suits scrolling and swiping, and it pairs automatically with a Mac.

specs.material: Natural herbs, resins, woods, and oils
specs.burn time: Fragrance lasts up to 24 hours in a room

record.description: Vetiver-scented incense sticks made from a blend of herbs, resins, woods and oils. The light, earthy, woodsy fragrance suits meditation, yoga, and worship, and the 11-inch sticks come in a 68-count pack totaling 200 grams.

specs.material: Dotted mesh with stretch lace trim

record.description: A women's unlined bralette with dotted mesh cups and stretch lace trim at the cups, underarm, and underband. Features adjustable double rouleau elastic straps and rose gold tone hardware for a customizable fit.

specs.features: Preheating function, variable temperature control

record.description: A pizza oven with a removable oven stone for even, crisp results on frozen, pre-baked, or fresh dough pizzas. It has upper and lower heating elements, a preheating function, and variable temperature control reaching roughly 625 to 680 degrees Fahrenheit.

A women's winter jacket that works three ways: wear the shell and liner together for full warmth, the shell alone against rain, or the liner alone. Its treated exterior resists water, dirt, and grease, and zip pockets hold small essentials. Suited to skiing, snowboarding, and hiking.

specs.feathers: Faux feathers in black, white, and blue

record.description: A deluxe feather headdress for Halloween costumes and themed parties. Its faux feathers come in black, white, and blue, with white marabou trim along the sides. It is sized to fit most teens and adults and pairs well with a Native American-style costume for role play and events.

Women's Rolex Datejust in the Ladies' President style, reference 179178. Features an 18k yellow gold case, bezel and bracelet paired with a silver dial and automatic movement. Listed in excellent condition, authenticated, serviced as needed, and covered by a one-year warranty after a final quality control check.

Six pairs of women's crew socks with assorted patterns and bright colors in one set. Made from a blend of combed cotton, spandex, and polyester for softness and a snug, elastic fit. Suited to athletic or everyday wear with sneakers, boots, or walking shoes.

A two-in-one matte lip crayon set with a built-in balm for hydration or added shine. Its light, buildable formula offers vivid matte coverage, and the pointed tip helps define lips. Choose from six shades, from natural nudes to bold reds.

A nine-foot beige patio umbrella with a tilting canopy, a hand-cranked lift, and five rectangular metal ribs on an aluminum frame. The water-resistant polyester top offers shade and UV protection, and a vent at the crown helps air flow. The base stand is sold separately; a base of about 73 pounds is recommended for stable use.

A four-pack of Mainstays 3-wick scented candles in a Mulled Cider fragrance, each burning in a glass jar. Designed to fill a room with warm, spiced aroma for gatherings or everyday relaxation. Store in a cool place for best results.

Lightweight mid-thigh shaping shorts from SPANX in a soft nude shade. The high-waisted microfiber design includes an engineered panel meant to smooth the lower stomach. A cotton gusset is intended to help reduce visible panty lines, and the shorts are offered in regular and plus sizes.

specs.care: Machine wash cool, tumble dry low

record.description: A lightweight, stretchy starter bralette for girls with a seamless, tag-free design and a racerback cut with no-show straps. Pads can be removed. Breathable fabric suits everyday wear, training, and active days.

Waterproof leather work boot with an alloy safety toe for industrial and construction use. Built on a women's last for a snug fit, with an all-weather TPU outsole and a footbed featuring anti-fatigue cushioning.

specs.coating: HDC multicoating and AquaDura coating on outer lenses

record.description: Compact binoculars offering 10x magnification with a bright, sharp optical system that resolves fine detail at a distance. A central focus knob allows quick, precise adjustment. Rubber-armored housing resists water to about 16.5 feet and the lens coatings help guard against water, dirt and scratches.

specs.material: PU leather cover, polycarbonate shell, ABS keyboard keys
specs.included: Case, Bluetooth keyboard, Micro USB cable, user manual

record.description: A slim protective case with a removable Bluetooth keyboard for the Samsung Galaxy Tab S4 10.5 (2018 models SM-T830, T835, T837). The keyboard has backlit keys with adjustable brightness, spring-backed tactile keys, and an adjustable stand for landscape viewing. A built-in holder fits an S Pen, which is sold separately.

A set of 100 wide-mouthed plastic straws designed for thick drinks like smoothies, milkshakes, and bubble tea. Each straw is long enough to reach the bottom of tall cups. The assorted bright colors suit parties, barbecues, and picnics, and the straws can be washed and reused or used once.

A women's rock climbing and bouldering shoe with a lace closure for adjustable fit. The leather upper is meant to offer some stretch and breathability, and the smooth last suits longer wear. Reinforced edge protection on the front upper helps the shoe keep its shape. The shape targets narrower, higher-instep female feet.

A box of 25 green letter-size folders with two laminated pockets and a high gloss finish. Each folder includes an interior die-cut business card holder. The laminated surface resists tearing better than standard paper folders, making them suited to presentations, client materials, and organizing documents.

specs.type: Convertible mittens with flip-back fingerless gloves
specs.insulation: 40 g 3M Thinsulate with orange microfiber fleece
specs.palm: Partial synthetic leather and silicone grip
specs.features: Windproof TPU membrane insert, wrist warmer pocket, reflective strips
specs.care: Machine wash warm, tumble dry low, no bleach

record.description: Winter gloves that flip from fully covered mittens to open-finger gloves using magnets, so your fingers stay free for tasks like fishing, photography, or phone use. Insulated with Thinsulate and fleece, with a windproof membrane and a textured palm for grip. Reflective strips add visibility in dark conditions.

specs.pockets: Two button-through welt pockets at rear

record.description: Men's slim-fit dress pants with a flat front and a tapered leg that is fitted through the hip and thigh. The smooth, flexible polyester twill offers easy movement, and the rear welt pockets have buttoned closures.

A lightweight women's hooded jacket lined in faux sheepskin for softness and comfort. The fixed hood has an echo-lamb lining, and the continuous double zipper closes with a personalized puller. Two pockets have invisible zips. It wind- and rain-resistant and folds into its own pouch for easy carrying.

specs.features: Cushioned soles and non-skid grippers

record.description: Six pairs of crew-length baby socks in a mix of cooling mesh and thermal waffle styles, suited to changing temperatures through the year. Cushioned soles add comfort, and non-skid grippers help reduce slipping. Machine washable and tumble-dryable.

Sheer organza ribbon on a 25-yard spool, with wired edges that help it hold shapes for bows, wreaths, and floral arrangements. The polyester base has a subtle sheen and is described as waterproof, suited to outdoor holiday decorations. Useful for gift wrapping and party decorating.

specs.pipe fit: 3.0 inch OD pipe to 3.0 inch ID pipe

record.description: A lap joint exhaust clamp that joins a 3-inch outer-diameter pipe to a 3-inch inner-diameter pipe without welding. It is removable and reusable, suited to exhaust tips, mufflers, and catback systems where serviceability matters. Requires adequate straight pipe length on each side and should not be installed close to a bend.

specs.use: Indoor and outdoor drop cloth for floors, furniture, and equipment

record.description: Heavy cotton canvas drop cloth measuring 9 by 12 feet, designed to shield floors, carpets, and furniture during painting or messy projects. It soaks up paint spills and traps dust and debris, and it can be machine washed for repeated use. Double-stitched seams help resist fraying.

Disposable stemmed cups with a clear, glass-like look for serving desserts, appetizers, mousse, or drinks at parties, weddings, and other events. Each set includes cups and bases, and the cups can be washed and reused if you prefer.

Field marking paint formulated for striping athletic fields. Designed for use upside down in an aerosol line-marking machine, and its universal tip is said to suit most marking machines. Sold as a case of 24 cans.

Rectangular full-rim sunglasses from Gucci with a dark havana plastic frame and green silver mirror lenses. The 57 mm lens width and 18 mm bridge suit a range of face sizes. Offers 100% UV protection. Non-polarized lenses.
A women's eau de parfum spray from Versace's Eros Pour Femme fragrance line, sold in a small 0.17 ounce bottle. The listing presents it as a single spray-format fragrance item.

specs.features: Water resistant, hand pockets, dual zipper

record.description: A lightweight women's long winter jacket with a hood, filled with 650-fill down for warmth. Water-resistant shell, secure hand pockets, and a dual zipper closure. Black, medium size.

specs.camera: Standard version without camera (30W/200W cameras optional)
specs.features: Altitude hold, GPS positioning, Return-to-Home, headless mode
specs.included: Quadcopter, remote, battery, 4 propellers, 4 protection rings, USB cable

record.description: A foldable mini quadcopter drone from Baoer with a 4-channel remote. It supports altitude hold, GPS tracking with a Return-to-Home function, and headless mode for simpler flying. Its replaceable arms make repairs easier. This standard version ships without a camera.

Reusable silicone ear plugs in three sizes, with ear hooks to help them stay in place overnight. The oval shape is designed to follow the ear canal and seal out noise. They can be washed and reused many times.

A high-rise, A-line maxi denim skirt with a full-length 35 inch hem. It has contrast stitching, curved waist, and functional front and back pockets. Fastens with three buttons and a zipper. Suitable for work, school, or casual outings.

Women's mid-rise active leggings with side stripe detailing, designed for training and everyday workouts. A flat, wide waistband and flatlock seams aim for comfort and freedom of movement. Seven-eighths length with a 25-inch inseam. Sized Large, in black with blue accents.

An oval metal wall sign celebrating Harley-Davidson, featuring an embossed Bar & Shield logo and script lettering. Its raised graphic adds dimension for a garage, workshop, or other room. Pre-punched holes make it easy to hang. A fitting gift for riders who love Harley-Davidson.

specs.power: one power per pack, not mixed
specs.included: 4 reading glasses

record.description: A four-pair set of oversized square reading glasses for women, all in one magnification of your choice. The plastic frames have spring hinges and a fashion-forward look. Suitable for reading at home or in the office. Clean the lenses gently, avoiding paper towels, alcohol, and harsh soaps.

specs.features: Open slots for audio jack, charger cable and volume buttons

record.description: A slim, lightweight silicone case for Apple iPhone 7 Plus and iPhone 8 Plus. Its smoke-tinted skeleton skull design adds a distinctive look while covering the phone's back and edges. Cutouts keep the audio jack, charging port and volume buttons accessible. The case is easy to remove and sold without the phone.

A multi-colored embroidery floss pack in a holiday color variation. Each skein has six strands and an over-dyed effect that shifts tones along the length. Made of cotton, suited to cross-stitch, embroidery, and other needlework projects.

A large 85-inch 4K QLED smart TV from Samsung's Q60A series. Quantum Dot color and Quantum HDR aim for vivid, wide-range color, while dual LED backlights adjust for contrast. Built-in Alexa support and machine-learning upscaling bring lower-resolution content closer to 4K.

specs.material: 18K white gold (listing also cites 925 sterling silver)
specs.style: Promise ring with round inlaid stones
specs.care: Store in box or bag away from water, perfume, and chemicals

record.description: A silver-toned promise ring from Aooaz with small round inlaid stones and a minimalist design. Suited to anniversaries, birthdays, Valentine's Day, or as a gift for a couple. Sold in multiple sizes; keep it stored separately and remove it before swimming or showering.

specs.sun protection: Omni-Shade blocks UVA and UVB rays

record.description: A long sleeve fishing shirt from Columbia's PFG line with a tribal-inspired fish graphic. Made from quick-drying polyester interlock with moisture-wicking technology and UV-blocking construction, it suits time on the water or around a campfire.

A five-pack of men's undershirts from Gildan in X-Large. Made mainly of cotton, with a soft feel and a tag-free design. The moisture-wicking fabric is meant to help keep the wearer cool and dry. Includes a double needle hem. Colors in the pack may vary.

specs.strap: 20mm black genuine leather, fits up to 8-inch wrist

record.description: A men's smartwatch from Timex with a black genuine leather strap and a white dial featuring green hour markers. It tracks steps, distance, calories and sleep, and pairs with a phone over Bluetooth. Its brass case has a mineral glass crystal and a backlight, and it is rated water resistant to 50 meters for recreational swimming, not diving.

Laceless kids' running shoe with a BOA dial closure for a snug, adjustable fit. Synthetic and mesh upper aims to keep the foot comfortable and breathable, while the REVlite midsole adds lightweight cushioning and the rubber outsole supports traction.

specs.noise and heat claims: Runs 35% cooler and 10% quieter than Envy Clipper (per listing)

record.description: A hair clipper with an alloy housing and an adjustable carbon steel blade that sets from 000 to 1 and can be zero-gapped. Its patent-pending XTR technology is meant to keep the motor running cooler and quieter, and its two-tone finish gives it a sleek look.

specs.care: Machine wash with like colors, tumble dry low, do not iron

record.description: A hooded men's bathrobe in black, made from Turkish cotton with loops on both sides to help absorb moisture. It has a wide hood, patch pockets, a self-fabric belt, and an ankle-length cut for after bathing, sauna, pool, or lounging at home.

A red ergonomic gaming chair from Scurrty with a height-adjustable seat and armrests, a 360-degree swivel, and a rocking function. It reclines between 90 and 170 degrees and includes a detachable headrest pillow and a lumbar cushion with USB-powered vibration massage. Suited to gaming, office work, or study, and it comes with the hardware needed for assembly.

A floor-length ball gown in royal blue sequined tulle, with a sweetheart neckline, sleeveless bodice, and 3D floral and pearl embellishments. Suited to quinceanera, prom, and formal evening events. Lace-up corset back and built-in bra.

A short-sleeve orange tee with a Tampa Bay football fan graphic. Made from 100% cotton, pre-shrunk, and screen printed in the USA. Machine washable for easy care. Offered in a range of sizes from small to 5X.

specs.connectivity: USB receiver or Bluetooth low energy
specs.software: Works with PowerPoint, Keynote, PDF, Google Slides; Logitech presentation app

record.description: A wireless presentation clicker with a laser pointer, offering USB or Bluetooth connection for use across Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android devices. It reaches up to about 20 meters, suiting medium to large rooms. Its companion app lets you remap buttons, track battery, and set a presentation timer.

Replacement tub spout for Delta faucets with a pull-out diverter for a hand shower. Chrome finish, designed to fit Delta faucets and made to original specifications. Fits 1/2 inch or 3/4 inch standard pipe.

A two-piece writing set with a stainless steel mechanical pencil and ballpoint pen in a silver finish. The knurled grip supports a steady hold, and the pencil uses 0.7mm HB lead while the pen takes 0.8mm black ink. Packaged as a gift set.

A quilted heated mattress pad with dual side controllers, each offering 10 heat settings to help warm sore areas on cold nights. Dual-sided heating aims for even warmth, and an auto-off feature adds peace of mind. Made of soft polyester that can be machine washed and dried.

A trunk-mounted rack that carries three bicycles on most sedans, hatchbacks, minivans, and SUVs. It arrives fully assembled, so installation is quick. Individual tie-downs hold each bike, side straps add stability, and the frame folds flat for compact storage when not in use.

specs.neckline: Off the shoulder, convertible to one shoulder, with shoulder, or strapless
specs.features: Layered ruffle, side thigh-high slit, elastic back panel

record.description: A floor-length evening dress with an off-the-shoulder neckline, layered ruffles, and a thigh-high side slit. The empire waist is ruched, and the back has elastic for a comfortable fit. It can be worn four ways and suits summer parties, dates, and casual outings.

A men's quartz wristwatch with a wooden case paired with a stainless steel bracelet. Its engraved back can be personalized, and it comes in a bamboo watch box, making it a thoughtful gift for birthdays, holidays, or special occasions. Lightweight and comfortable to wear, it suits both casual and business settings.

specs.style: Luxfer Prism, Frank Lloyd Wright inspired

record.description: A 14-inch wall clock with a Luxfer Prism design inspired by Frank Lloyd Wright. Its cream dial has raised hour markers and shadowed graphics, and bronze rods surround the face. A quartz crystal movement keeps time. Made by Bulova for modern rooms.

specs.rear camera: 13 MP main with PDAF; 5 MP 120° super wide

record.description: An unlocked LG K31 smartphone in silver with 32 GB of storage. It has a 5.7-inch HD+ display, a 13 MP main rear camera with fast focus, a 5 MP super wide rear camera, and a 5 MP front camera with portrait mode. A 3,000 mAh battery is included.

A double-sided tabletop makeup mirror offering regular magnification on one side and 10X on the other for detailed close-up work. The glass mirror rotates a full 360 degrees and can be locked at any angle. Its lightweight, classic design also works handheld.

specs.included items: Tote, tool set, pens, blade, digital guide
specs.guide format: Digital eBook, emailed; no paper copy

record.description: A starter bundle for Cricut Joy machine users, combining a carrying tote with a padded interior and pockets, a three-piece tool set for weeding and applying vinyl, three fine-point pens, a replacement blade, and a digital guide to Cricut smart materials.

A dainty evil eye pendant necklace with a hammered finish and a cubic zirconia accent. The gold-plated brass chain has an adjustable extension and suits everyday wear, parties, or gifting. Arrives in a gift box. Avoid chemicals, sweat, and bathing to help it last.

specs.included: Extra 15-watt bulb, instruction manual, gift box

record.description: A hand-carved pink Himalayan salt lamp with a unique shape and a neem wood base. Its integrated dimmer lets you adjust the warm glow for day or night use. Arrives fully assembled in a gift box with a spare bulb, making it a relaxing accent for a bedroom, living room, or as a housewarming gift.

A stovetop espresso maker from GROSCHE's Milano line that brews rich, dense coffee using the classic Moka pot method. Cup sizes are measured in espresso cups rather than standard mugs. Made of anodized aluminum, it works on gas and electric stoves and camping burners, but not on induction. Hand washing is recommended.

Men's lace-up sneaker from adidas Originals with a knit upper and breathable mesh lining. Features webbing tape with 3-Stripes branding, a nubuck heel accent, and an OrthoLite sockliner for added comfort. The speed lacing system allows quick, snug fitting.

Unisex stud earrings with a magnetic clasp instead of a traditional pin, so they suit both pierced and non-pierced ears. Stainless steel bases are set with cubic zirconia in a square shape. Two pairs come in white and black, and the set is described as gentle on sensitive ears.

Relaxed-fit knit Bermuda shorts with a longer length for everyday wear. Pull-on design with an elasticized waistband and side pockets. Made from a soft cotton and polyester blend that is easy to care for by machine washing.

specs.material: Food-grade silicone-coated wire with stainless steel handle
specs.handle: Non-slip stainless steel with hanging hole

record.description: A 10-inch silicone whisk for blending, whisking, beating, stirring, cooking, and baking. The wire is coated in food-grade silicone that is meant to be gentle on cookware, and the non-slip stainless steel handle includes a hanging hole for storage. The coating is described as heat resistant and easy to clean.

specs.compartments: 1 bill section and 1 kiss lock coin pocket

record.description: A tri-fold women's wallet in soft synthetic leather with a snap closure. It has a bowknot design with a small cat charm, 13 card slots, two clear photo slots, a bill section, and a kiss-lock coin pocket. Sized for everyday cards, bills, and coins.

specs.style: Tufted storage bench with crystal-like accents

record.description: A tufted storage bench offering both extra seating and hidden storage for a sitting room, entryway, or bedroom. Its padded top doubles as a footrest. The grey bonded-leather upholstery sits over a hardwood frame, with crystal-like accents adding a touch of sparkle to traditional decor.

specs.count: 60 vinyl sheets plus 10 transfer tape sheets
specs.use: Indoor and outdoor on smooth surfaces; not for fabric

record.description: A craft vinyl set with 60 permanent adhesive-backed sheets in 30 shades, plus 10 clear transfer tape sheets for positioning designs. Sheets are sized for craft cutters, can be applied to smooth surfaces such as mugs, tumblers, and walls, and tolerate washing and rain. Not suitable for fabric.

specs.design: One-piece slip-on case with raised beveled screen edge

record.description: A slim one-piece protective case for the Apple iPhone X, made from a synthetic rubber interior with a polycarbonate outer shell. It has a raised lip to guard the touchscreen and slips easily on and off. This listing is for a certified refurbished unit, which has been tested, cleaned, and repackaged.

A women's full-zip fleece jacket from Columbia's Benton Springs line, made from soft polyester fleece for warmth. It has a collared neck, two side zippered pockets for small items, and a lightweight, active cut suited to outdoor activity and cold days.

A rechargeable sonic toothbrush for adults with five cleaning modes and three intensity levels.
