Its built-in smart timer runs two-minute sessions and pauses at 30-second intervals to prompt switching zones. Medium-soft W-shaped bristles are paired with a protective cover for travel. Charges via a standard USB port.

A six-bunch package of live Giant Hairgrass, a freshwater aquarium plant that forms a dense background cover. Its root system helps draw nutrients from the substrate, and the plants release oxygen while absorbing carbon dioxide and nutrients that come from fish waste in the water.

A cozy wearable blanket for big kids, made from soft micro-fleece with a playful dog design. Its sack-style cut gives legs room to move while keeping the blanket in place through the night. Foot openings let children walk around when awake, and a 1.0 TOG rating suits lighter bedtime warmth.

specs.bottoms: Relaxed fit, no-fly string waist, side pockets on flannel styles

record.description: Novelty pajama set with a crewneck top and relaxed-fit bottoms made from soft cotton. Designed to look like everyday lounge wear, it suits lounging around the house or sleeping. Available in many plaid and print combinations, and makes a casual gift.

specs.midsole insert: Full-length EVA with Poron foam under forefoot

record.description: Men's leather lace-up shoe from Timberland with a handsewn upper stitched to the midsole and cemented to the outsole. Features 360-degree rawhide lacing for a snug fit, a leather lining and footbed, and layered cushioning with an EVA insert and forefoot foam. A rubber lug outsole adds traction.

specs.seat dimensions: 23.50 in deep x 45.00 in wide x 17.75 in high
specs.accents: Nail head accents on scrolled arms

record.description: A traditional Chesterfield loveseat with deep button tufting, nail head accents on the front of its scrolled arms, and turned legs. The tufting is designed to offer breathing room and limit heat while you relax. The listing names navy blue and dark brown as its finish colors.

specs.included: 3 plates, exhaust adaptor, sealing tape, 4 butterfly screws

record.description: Window sealing kit for portable air conditioners that vent through a hose. The plates slot together and slide to fit a range of sliding window widths. Designed for a 5.9-inch exhaust hose opening, so check your unit's vent size before buying. Includes an exhaust adaptor, sealing tape, and screws for installation.

A unisex crewneck sweatshirt featuring a screen-printed Hawkins Middle School AV Club design in white ink. Made from a 50/50 blend for a soft feel. The fit typically runs large for women, so consider sizing accordingly. Makes a thoughtful gift for fans of the show.

specs.handle: 5/8 inch diameter marine grade 12 strand nylon

record.description: A compact underwater viewing bucket for small boats, kayaks, paddle boards, and shore use. Its clear acrylic lens shows a 9 inch area below the surface, and a lens protector lets you fill it without scratching. The thick rope handle is easy to grip and carry, and stainless steel hooks allow buckets to be stacked.

A cordless, hoseless pool vacuum for inground and above ground pools, with a rechargeable lithium ion battery that runs up to 45 minutes per charge. Push-button start, a removable head for spot cleaning, and a filter bag designed for easy emptying.

A full-frame DSLR camera from Canon with a 20.1 megapixel sensor and DIGIC X processor. It records 4K video, has dual CFexpress card slots, and offers a 191-point autofocus system. The bundle includes a CFexpress card and reader.

A rustic wall sign spelling HOME across separate wooden tiles with white lettering. Its distressed wood look suits farmhouse and country decor. Pre-installed hooks and string make it easy to hang in a kitchen, dining room, living room, or bedroom. The tiles can also be hung individually. A welcoming housewarming gift.

A low-profile wall mount for flat-panel TVs and monitors from 37 to 80 inches, including flat and curved screens. It holds up to 130 pounds and sits about 1.84 inches off the wall. Lateral shift helps center the display between studs, and the open wall plate leaves room for concealed cable management.

specs.included: Rod sections, rubber end caps, user manual

record.description: A spring-loaded tension rod that expands to fit windows, doorways, and other openings without drilling. Its powder-coated steel frame resists rust, and it can hold lightweight to heavy curtains. Suitable for bathrooms, bedrooms, patios, and laundry areas.

A steel storage cabinet with four adjustable shelves for organizing documents, supplies, tools, or household goods. It has a built-in lock with two keys, and a black powder-coated frame that resists corrosion. Four rubber casters, two lockable, make it easy to move. Assembly is required.

A long-sleeve grey romper bodysuit for newborns and infants up to three months. Its soft, stretchy cotton-blend fabric is breathable and gentle on delicate skin. Snap closure at the bottom simplifies diaper changes, and the wide neckline makes dressing easier. Suitable for everyday wear or as a baby shower gift.

A limited edition Sakura notebook from Moleskine with a hard cover, a large 5 by 8.25 inch format, and 240 ruled pages. Includes an elastic closure band and inner storage folders for notes and writing projects.

specs.sole: Rubber with soft spikes and sensory pods
specs.features: Memory foam footbed, toe cap, stretchy knit collar

record.description: Soft mesh first-walker sneakers for babies learning to walk. The breathable upper keeps little feet cool and dry, while the rubber sole with grip pods helps reduce slipping. A toe cap adds protection, and a stretchy collar makes them easy to slip on and off.

specs.key ingredients: Carnauba wax, beeswax, cetearyl alcohol, tea extract

record.description: A temporary hair color wax that doubles as a styling cream, letting you mould, sculpt and add texture while tinting hair in violet. Designed for parties, festivals, cosplay and Halloween, it rinses out with warm water and is intended for occasional, non-permanent use.

specs.included: 24W mini UV lamp, nano nail file, 2 toe separators, USB cable

record.description: Compact UV LED nail lamp for curing gel polish and top coat at home. Features a 120W main lamp with 36 beads, an automatic motion sensor, and four timer settings with an LCD display. Includes a foldable 24W mini lamp for travel. Fits both hands and feet.

A compact electric hand mixer with seven speeds and a turbo function for whipping, mixing, and kneading everyday baking ingredients. It includes two beaters and two dough hooks made of chrome-plated stainless steel, which store on the base. The body wipes clean with a damp cloth, and the attachments are dishwasher-safe.

A full motion wall mount for flat panel TVs and computer monitors from about 13 to 40 inches. The arm extends from 2 to 15 inches off the wall and tilts, swivels, and rotates for comfortable viewing. It can hold screens in landscape or portrait orientation and supports up to 33 pounds.

A soft acrylic yarn with a subtle silk-like sheen, suited to lightweight spring and summer garments. Each skein offers about 383 yards, and the set includes four skeins for hand knitting or crochet projects. The listed colorway is cream.

specs.pattern: Watercolor cowboy riding horse and calf roping, printed on two sides
specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, no bleach, tumble dry low

record.description: A decorative throw pillow cover featuring a watercolor-style cowboy scene printed on both sides. Made from a cotton and linen blend, it has a hidden zipper for easy insertion. The 18 by 18 inch cover is sized for standard pillow forms, which are sold separately.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

record.description: A reversible throw in soft sherpa fabric with a colorful patchwork of floral and geometric patterns. Suits cottage, bohemian, or modern decor, and works well in a living room, at the foot of a bed, in a nursery, or as a gift. Easy to care for in the machine.

specs.runtime: Up to 5 hours brightest, 120 hours darkest

record.description: A rechargeable touch-sensor light that sticks on almost anywhere, such as closets, under cabinets, and stairs. Its 100 degree swivel head lets you aim the light up or down. Touch the metal pins to switch modes and dim, and it remembers your last brightness setting.

specs.care: Machine washable, cold water, gentle cycle; no bleach or iron

record.description: Square velvet throw pillow covers in a golden yellow striped pattern, sold as a set of two. The removable covers have invisible zippers and suit sofas, beds, chairs, and other seating. Pillow inserts are not included and must be bought separately. Machine washable on a gentle cold cycle.

Individually wrapped essential oil towelettes meant for cleaning hands and surfaces on the go. Offered as a natural alternative to alcohol-based wipes, they fit easily into a purse, bag, or pocket for travel.

specs.type: Front door wreath with pine cones

record.description: A red holiday wreath for the front door, decorated with pine cones and a string of 50 battery-powered LED lights. A built-in timer runs the lights for 6 hours and then rests them for 18, so the display lights up at dusk without manual switching. Batteries are sold separately.

specs.use: Conceals pole at base of artificial Christmas tree

record.description: A reversible collar that wraps around the pole at the base of an artificial Christmas tree. One side shows a brown bark pattern and the other a candy pattern. It can be folded or trimmed to fit most poles, and it is sized to suit poles up to about 6.5 inches around.

specs.size: 7.4 x 7.4 x 2.3 inches (L x H x W)
specs.pattern: Leopard snakeskin print on front pocket

record.description: A small round crossbody bag for women, made from soft PU leather with gold-tone hardware. It can be carried as a shoulder bag or worn crossbody. The main compartment fits a phone, keys, lipstick and a wallet, and it suits everyday outings, parties, or travel.

specs.controls: 6-setting browning dials, dual reheat, defrost, bagel buttons

record.description: A four-slice toaster with two independent control panels, so each side can be set separately. Brushed stainless housing, wide slots for thick bread and bagels, a lift lever, and a slide-out crumb tray for easy cleaning. Includes an instruction book.

specs.compatibility: Select Chevrolet, GMC, and Isuzu models

record.description: Replacement front driver side window regulator for select Chevrolet, GMC, and Isuzu vehicles. Designed to match the shape, dimensions, and function of the original part. Cycle-tested for durable service. Confirm fitment for your exact make, model, and trim before purchase.

specs.key ingredients: Garlic, parsley, chlorophyll, aged black garlic extract

record.description: Odorless garlic softgels combining garlic with parsley, chlorophyll, and aged black garlic extract. Positioned as a supplement for heart, blood pressure, cholesterol, and immune system support. Made with flaxseed oil as a carrier.

specs.included: Mouthpiece with ligature and cap, cleaning cloth, carrying strap
specs.case: Light rectangular case with back pack assembly

record.description: Student-level Eb alto saxophone from Roy Benson with a brass body finished in red lacquer and lacquered brass-tone keys. Includes a high F# key and a connected C#-Bb table key. Comes with a mouthpiece, ligature and cap, cleaning cloth, carrying strap, and a lightweight rectangular case with backpack straps.
A women's wrap-style dress from JOA with a surplice neckline and an abstract floral print in ivory and black. Short flutter sleeves add a feminine touch. Offered in size small.

Disposable black plastic straws sold in a dispenser box of 500. At just over seven inches long, they suit most soft and hard drinks. Made from food-grade, BPA-free polypropylene with a glossy finish, they work for bars, parties, food service, and home use.

Replacement nylon mesh filter bags for Polaris 360 and 380 pool cleaners. Sold as a two-pack, each bag has a zipper opening for quick emptying of leaves and debris, and fine mesh intended to trap small particles. Attaches with a snap-on cuff. Not intended for Polaris 280 or 480 models.

specs.included characters: Kion, Fuli, Bunga, Ono, Beshte, Simba, Nala, Rafiki, Timon, Pumbaa

record.description: A ten-piece set of Pride Lands characters from Disney Junior's The Lion Guard. Each three-inch figure is posed in an action stance, suited to both play and display on a shelf.

A lightweight graphic tee with a classic fit and double-needle stitching on the sleeves and bottom hem. Its playful sarcastic saying suits moms, daughters, aunts, uncles, and grandmas, and it works as a holiday or gag gift.

A bloom enhancer for flowering plants, supplying minerals and amino acids to support abundant flowering and fruit production. Designed to be used alongside BioThrive bloom fertilizer. Sold in a one-quart bottle.

A napkin box with a beaded sand dollar motif, made from recycled sandcast aluminum and designed by Michael Updike. It is not suitable for the dishwasher. A tabletop piece for holding napkins at meals or gatherings.

specs.closure: Zipper coin pocket and snap fastener flip cover

record.description: A slim badge holder and wallet that clips to a detachable neck lanyard. It has a clear front ID window, four card slots, a zippered coin pocket, and a cash mezzanine. A snap-fastened flip cover protects cards, and RFID blocking guards against high-frequency scans. Cards with 125 kHz chips are not shielded.

specs.care: Machine washable, tumble dry on low

record.description: A set of four extra-large white bath sheets made from 100% cotton. Each measures 31 by 63 inches and is designed to absorb water quickly. Suitable for bathrooms, guest rooms, pools, beaches, and gym use. Machine washable and tumble dry on low.

specs.printing: Permanently dyed into the case, not a sticker or vinyl
specs.cutouts: Openings for buttons and camera lens

record.description: A protective TPU phone case for several iPhone models, featuring a Bangtan Boys Love Yourself design for fans. The image is dyed into the material rather than applied as a sticker. Cutouts keep buttons and the camera lens easy to reach.

specs.style: Footed sleeper pajamas with zip-up front

record.description: Footed cotton sleeper pajamas for babies in a snug fit, with a zip-up front for easy dressing and changing. The dotted pattern adds a playful look for bedtime. Sized for 18-month-olds.

specs.material: Soft, comfortable fabric that resists wrinkles and fading
specs.care: Hand or machine wash, hang dry, do not bleach

record.description: A soft, short-sleeve casual dress for girls in a solid white shade that pairs easily with other pieces. Resists wrinkles and fading, and suits school, parties, beach days, or everyday wear. Can be layered with coats or leggings across seasons. Hand or machine wash, then hang to dry.

specs.set composition: 12 each of three 8-color sets (basic, glitter, metallic)
specs.formula: Washable, wipes off skin and most clothing

record.description: A classroom-sized assortment of watercolor paint sets for schools, camps, or home use. Includes basic, glitter, and metallic palettes, each with a brush. The washable formula rinses off skin and most fabrics, and the non-toxic paints carry AP certification.

specs.graphic: I Can't Make Everyone Happy - I'm Not A Taco

record.description: A lightweight tee with a vintage-style graphic reading I Can't Make Everyone Happy, I'm Not A Taco. It features a classic fit and double-needle stitching at the sleeves and bottom hem. A playful choice for anyone with a sense of humor about tacos.

A pen-shaped capacitive stylus with a metal body and two replaceable rubber tips, one at each end. The smaller 4.5 mm tip suits precise taps and drawing, while the 6 mm tip covers broader strokes. Tips swap out quickly without tools. Works with most tablets and smartphones. Four styluses come in black, blue, purple, and red.

specs.size range: US Toddler 5M to US Little Kid 3M

record.description: Casual slip-on canvas sneakers for kids with a leopard print upper and white soles. The elastic tongue makes them easy to put on and take off. Soft uppers and flexible rubber soles suit running, jumping, and play, and a reinforced toe cap adds protection. Choose size by measuring foot length.

A pack of 100 through-hole infrared emitter LEDs with a 5 mm clear round lens and a 850 nm output that is invisible to the eye. Two-pin leads with marked polarity suit DIY electronics, IR beam sensing, and remote-style projects. Operates at low voltage and current.

specs.product type: 2 in 1 transforming pullover hoodie and plushie

record.description: A soft plush kitty that unfolds into a pullover hoodie, so a child can switch between a cuddly toy and a warm top. Made from a cotton blend with a full lining, featuring animal ears on the hood and a soft-tipped zipper pull. Suited to ages 2 to 10 and machine washable.

specs.compatibility: GE, Hotpoint, Kenmore ranges and cooktops
specs.features: Locking slot

record.description: Replacement porcelain drip pans for range cooktops, sold as a set of four with two 6-inch and two 8-inch black bowls. Designed to catch drippings and food falling from the oven element. Compatible with listed GE, Hotpoint, and Kenmore range models. Installation involves removing the element and swapping the old pan for the new one.

specs.neck: Coverseamed neck with lay flat collar

record.description: Men's short-sleeve tee sold as a four-pack in a light steel shade. Its full cut offers a roomier fit, and double-needle stitching on the sleeves and hem adds durability. The light steel version blends 90% cotton with 10% polyester for everyday comfort.

Arrowroot starch from Bob's Red Mill, offered as a flour in a 16-ounce package. A single pantry item for home kitchens, suited to cooking and baking projects where arrowroot is called for. Sold as one package.

specs.style: Sleeveless V-neck romper with spaghetti straps
specs.care: Cold water wash, do not bleach, hang or line dry

record.description: A sleeveless floral romper with a V-neckline and spaghetti straps, made from lightweight fabric with some stretch. Suited to beach outings, vacations, casual days and summer parties. Wash in cold water, do not bleach, and hang or line dry.

specs.material: Stainless steel wire with coated cotton rope
specs.features: Bell and hook connectors

record.description: A pair of flexible rope perches for birds, each about 63 inches long. The wire core lets you shape them straight or curved, and the hooks fasten them to cage or perch positions. Colorful cotton rope invites chewing, and the attached bell adds sound and play value for small and medium parrots.

specs.use: Trash can replacement liner or storage bag

record.description: A roll of 20 black disposable plastic trash bags made from PE, sized 46 by 60 centimeters. Designed as a replacement liner for household and office bins, they are described as thicker than typical bags and suited to restaurants, homes, and hotels. Can also serve as storage bags.

A rectangular kitchen recycling bin with dual inner buckets for sorting trash and recyclables side by side. A touch bar opens the wide lid hands-free, and a stay-open feature keeps it up during food prep. Dampers and angled springs help the lid open smoothly and evenly.

A compact Blu-ray player from Panasonic that starts up quickly and plays 1080p discs. It upscales standard and 720p content to 1080p, supports SDXC and USB media for photos and AVCHD video, and is designed to use less power than earlier models.

specs.material: Faux shearling lining, felt upper, TPR outsole

record.description: Men's slipper with a soft faux shearling lining and stretchy elastic goring for an easy, secure fit. Moccasin clog styling with a felt upper suits indoor wear or quick outdoor trips. Durable TPR outsole and a replaceable semi-cemented insole add support.

specs.case compatibility: Smooth and hard cases; not silicone, highly textured, or many soft cases

record.description: A collapsible grip and stand for phones and tablets that gives a secure hold for one-handed texting, steadier photos, and hands-free viewing. It attaches to smooth, hard cases and is not designed for silicone or heavily textured covers.

A three-pack of soft, stretchy diaper covers in white for babies up to six months old. The four-way stretch fabric is meant to move with the baby and keep a snug fit. Snaps are reinforced for durability.

specs.graphic: The Rolling Stones distressed Union Jack design at front

record.description: A men's crew-neck T-shirt in white, featuring a distressed Union Jack graphic with a Rolling Stones design across the front. Officially licensed merchandise in XX-Large.

specs.cushioning: Zone cushioning in heel and toe

record.description: Six pairs of women's ankle socks from Hanes, designed to fit women's shoe sizes 5 to 9. The Comfort Fit design supports the arch, while targeted zone cushioning in the heel and toe adds comfort without bulk. X-Temp technology is built in to help manage body temperature through the day.

A contemporary overstuffed loveseat with a clean, simple silhouette and track arms, upholstered in a durable performance fabric. Down-filled cushions provide a deep, comfortable seat, and the reversible seat cushion is removable. The solid hardwood frame is paired with stain resistant, moisture repellent fabric.
A soft, comfortable white sundress for girls with a short sleeve and a swing hem with a twirly shape. Its solid color pairs easily with jackets or cardigans for everyday wear across several seasons.

specs.included: 1 bike, 1 tool installation package
specs.monitor: Tracks time, speed, distance, and calories

record.description: A home spinning bike for indoor cardio workouts, with an adjustable saddle and handlebar and a monitor that tracks time, speed, distance, and calories. Arrives with a tool kit, and the stabilizers, pedals, saddle, and handle need assembly before use.

specs.style: Classic slip-on with stretch side gore panels

record.description: Classic slip-on sneaker for men with a white canvas upper and vulcanized rubber outsole. Side gore panels stretch for easy on and off, while a cushioned insole and padded collar support everyday comfort. Breathable lining helps keep the fit comfortable.

specs.included: 3 batteries, dual charger, carrying case, 21 mounts and accessories

record.description: Action camera for travel, extreme sports, and vlogging, recording 4K Ultra HD video and taking 12MP photos with a wide 170-degree view. Includes a remote control, Wi-Fi app connectivity, and an IPX8 waterproof case for use down to about 30 meters. The kit adds spare batteries, a dual charger, and a carrying case with mounts.

A 192-piece mechanics tool set from DEWALT for automotive and general repair work. Pieces have a polished chrome vanadium finish, a knurled control ring for grip and adjustment, and hand-stamped markings for easy size identification.

specs.model: Men's Nitro Low MC Football Shoe

record.description: Men's football cleat in midnight navy with white accents. Features a support cage built from coated textile and synthetic panels, a breathable open-mesh tongue, and a molded toe cap for added protection. A TPU heel clip and die-cut EVA sockliner add stability and cushioning.
Socks decorated with a playful all-over design of beagles and paw prints. Made from a cotton, nylon, and spandex blend, they are sized for U.S. women's shoe sizes 5 through 10.5.

specs.included offer: 2 years of Instant Ink (based on 100 pages/month)

record.description: A wireless all-in-one inkjet printer for home use that handles printing, scanning, and copying. Includes automatic two-sided printing and a code for two years of Instant Ink delivery. Setup is guided through the HP Smart app, which also supports mobile printing and scanning from smartphones.

A 12-inch vinyl magnet showing the Georgia Bulldogs NCAA team logo. Made from heavy gauge magnetic vinyl, it sticks easily to metal surfaces such as a car's body, letting fans display team pride on the go.
Nail polish from the Zoya brand in the shade named Hunter, supplied in a 0.5 fluid ounce bottle. Intended for applying color to nails as part of a manicure.

specs.compartments: main, front organizer pocket, mesh side pocket

record.description: A men's backpack from Hurley in black with a 21-liter capacity. It has a main compartment with a laptop sleeve, a front pocket with an internal organizer, and a mesh side pocket sized for most water bottles. The bottom has a water-resistant coating.

A lightweight Nike running shoe for young children, with a hook-and-loop closure for easy on and off and a secure fit. Breathable mesh upper, cushioned heel, and a flexible rubber outsole provide everyday comfort and traction.

specs.valve type: 3-way T valve with shut-off and ceramic valve
specs.included: 1 T adapter, 2 cone washers, 1 filter screen washer, 1 hose connector
specs.compatibility: Most American toilets; not for shower heads or faucet diverters

record.description: A chrome-plated brass T adapter that lets one toilet supply line feed both the toilet and a bidet. The built-in valve shuts off or adjusts water pressure to the bidet without changing toilet flow. A screen washer helps catch sediment. Designed for standard American 7/8 inch fittings.

specs.material: Steel frame, powder coated finish, environmental particle board

record.description: A 55-inch home office computer desk with a steel frame and powder-coated espresso finish. The particle board top includes two grommets to help route cords. Adjustable glides help keep the desk steady on uneven floors, and assembly hardware with instructions is included.

A keg coupler for tapping American D System Sankey kegs so you can pour domestic beers directly from the keg. Its clickable lever engages the keg without pulling the handle out first. The stainless steel probe and body suit demanding commercial settings such as bars and restaurants, and a built-in valve releases keg pressure.

A self-balancing electric scooter with 6.5-inch wheels, UL 2272 certification, and a rated weight range of 44 to 220 pounds. Features RGB LED lights, a built-in Bluetooth speaker, and 200W brushless motors for straight riding, turning, and spinning in place. Suited to kids and adults.

A woven falsa blanket from Mexico, suited to yoga practice or cozy use on the sofa during cold evenings. Its thick, soft construction measures about 76 by 53 inches. Machine washable for easy care. Each handmade piece may show slight shade differences from the pictured color.

specs.contents: 2 lowball glasses (8 oz), 2 sandstone coasters, 6 soapstone whiskey stones

record.description: A gift set for fans of the New Orleans Saints, with two heavy-bottomed lowball glasses, two sandstone coasters, and six soapstone stones that chill whiskey without diluting it. The contents fit securely in a solid oak box.

specs.care: Wash inside out with cold water
specs.design: United States of America flag, vintage style

record.description: A vintage-style American flag t-shirt in navy blue, made from a cotton blend for a comfortable, modern fit. Printed in the United States, it suits patriotic occasions such as the Fourth of July or as a gift for anyone who loves the USA. Wash inside out in cold water.

specs.features: Misting function, neon light

record.description: A handheld, battery-operated personal fan that also sprays a fine mist for quicker cooling. It has three speeds, a 180-degree adjustable head, and a foldable design that clips easily to a backpack or sits on a desk. A USB-rechargeable battery supports use during travel or camping.

A single-DIN car stereo with Bluetooth for hands-free calls and wireless music, plus FM radio with automatic and manual tuning. It supports USB charging, AUX input, and TF/SD card playback, and includes a wireless remote and multicolor LED lighting.

specs.compatibility: MacBook Pro 2017/2016, MacBook Air 2016/2015, Galaxy S8/Note 8, Chromebook Pixel

record.description: Compact USB-C to HDMI adapter that supports video up to 4K at 60Hz on compatible laptops and phones. Its foldable design with a short cable suits travel, and its braided nylon cable is designed to protect against spills. Works alongside an Apple charging cable.

A flexible single-face corrugated cardboard roll for wrapping fragile items such as glass and metal parts. Its raised A-flutes cushion against shock and resist crushing, and the wrap conforms to many shapes. Made from recyclable material.

A self-propelled gas lawn mower for smaller yards, with a 170cc four-stroke engine and a 20-inch steel deck. It offers side discharge, mulching, and rear bagging, plus eight cutting heights and rear-wheel drive for easier handling on uneven ground.

specs.product line: Oh So Light Comfort Flex Fit

record.description: Wire-free bra from Hanes' Oh So Light line, designed for a lightweight, second-skin feel. Flexible foam cups offer shape and support, while the comfort band helps it stay in place. Sleek styling is meant to stay virtually invisible under clothing. Available in black/nude, size 2X.

specs.material: Waxed canvas with leather handle straps

record.description: A handmade insulated lunch bag made from waxed canvas, with a reinforced carry handle and a lining that helps keep food warm or cold. Standing about 9 inches tall, it is roomy enough for a full lunch and simple to wipe clean, suiting work, school, or picnics.

A soft plush unicorn with a white body and vivid purple mane and tail. Its hooves and horn carry shimmering patterned fabric, and weighted hooves help it stand steadily on a shelf or table. Made with plush and fill, and the surface can be wiped clean.

A four-piece twin bedding set in navy made from 100% cotton with a 500 thread count sateen weave for a smooth, soft feel. Includes a flat sheet, a fitted sheet with deep pockets, and two pillowcases. Machine washable for easy care.

specs.product type: Cup holder phone mount with wireless charger
specs.compatibility: iPhone 11 to 13 series, Samsung Galaxy S8 to S21 and Note series
specs.power adapter: QC2.0 or QC3.0 car adapter required, not included
specs.case limit: Phones with cases thicker than 5 mm cannot charge

record.description: A car cup holder mount that holds a phone at an adjustable aluminum arm and clamps it automatically when docked. It offers Qi wireless charging with power adjusted between 5W, 7.5W and 10W depending on the device. Thick cases over 5 mm are not supported, and a QC2.0 or QC3.0 car adapter is needed for fast charging.
A long-sleeve pullover dress for toddler girls, made from a cotton and polyester jersey blend. It features an allover fair isle print, a crew neckline, and an elasticized waist for easy wear.

A compact square side table with a lower shelf for extra storage beside a sofa or bed. Its steel tubing frame is built to feel sturdy, and the wood grain finish wipes clean easily. Assembly is simple, and the footprint suits small rooms.

specs.included: 2 medium plugs, 1 large plug
specs.uses: cleaning, storage, odor proofing glass pieces

record.description: A set of plugs and caps designed to fit most glass joints, whether male or female, for cleaning glass water pipes and rigs. The included pieces create a tight seal to help contain contents during transport and reduce odor. Includes two medium plugs and one large plug in black.

A golf swing training aid meant to help build grip, release, tempo, and swing consistency. It has a training grip that positions the thumb and index finger, and a heavier head to add resistance during practice. Designed for right-handed golfers.

specs.material: Fiber-reinforced polycarbonate and stainless steel hardware
specs.included: Mounting knob

record.description: A dual tray for underwater cameras that holds two lights or flashes at once, aiming to reduce shadows and steady the rig. Flex arms, grips, and lights attach with a click and release with a button. Fits cameras with a standard 1/4-20 tripod socket.

specs.style: Straight taper with glitter pink heart pattern
specs.included: Two rubber O-rings

record.description: A clear acrylic ear taper with a pink heart pattern and glitter accents, sized at 12mm or 1/2 inch. Sold as a single piece, so buy two for a matching pair. Includes two rubber O-rings.

specs.material: E1 standard wood panel, metal frame
specs.assembly: 4 legs with hex key, about 5-10 minutes

record.description: A spacious 63-inch computer desk with a simple square worksurface, suited to home offices, workstations, or use as a meeting or conference table. The wood panel is water-resistant with a scratch-resistant surface that wipes clean, and the metal frame adds support. Legs adjust slightly for uneven floors, and assembly takes only a few minutes.

specs.use: Display in kitchen, dining room, curio cabinet or shelf

record.description: A set of six clear display easels that hold a teacup with its saucer standing behind, so both pieces stay visible. Suited to showing collectible dishware in a kitchen, dining room, curio cabinet, or on a shelf. Works as a gift for a dishware collector.

A multi-pack of eight pairs of graduated compression socks for women and men, suited to running, travel, flights, nursing shifts, and everyday wear. The nylon-rich blend aims to offer comfort, breathability, and moisture absorption. Listed as 15-20 mmHg compression intended to support circulation and reduce leg fatigue.

specs.material: Solid polished brass with wood handle

record.description: A large vintage-style school bell made of solid polished brass with a wooden handle. It works both as a decorative piece and as a functional bell, and measures 12 inches high and 5.5 inches long.

A long sleeve fishing tee with built-in UPF 50 sun protection and quick-drying polyester interlock fabric that moves moisture away from the skin. Its classic fit suits outdoor trips on the water or on land.

A pack of ten black gel ink pens with a 0.38 mm tip for smooth, everyday writing. The pigment-based ink is noted for being waterproof and fade-resistant, suited to notes, calendars, and general tasks.

specs.material: 300GSM cardboard, plastic window, natural jute twine

record.description: Fourteen black bakery boxes with an openable window for cupcakes, macarons, cookies, and other treats. Each box folds together and includes a jute twine bundle for wrapping and carrying. Suited to party favors, birthdays, and holiday gatherings, with a blank panel for custom decoration.

specs.style: Bib overall shorts with ripped, raw hem

record.description: Women's denim bib overall shorts with distressed detailing and a cuffed raw hem. Adjustable straps and metal buckles offer a flexible fit. Four pockets add practical storage. Suited to casual, street, and summer wear.

specs.included: Drawstring jewelry pouch

record.description: Sparkling stud earrings set with princess-cut cubic zirconia in a cushion-shaped halo design. Sterling silver with a rhodium plating, sized for everyday wear or gifting. Comes with a drawstring pouch for storage or presentation. Suitable for many occasions.

specs.product type: Last Will and Testament forms and instructions
specs.included: Registration instructions and preprinted sample form for use as a rough draft

record.description: A downloadable kit with forms and instructions for drafting a will in the United States. Register the product to access the forms and state-specific content. The kit covers naming beneficiaries, allocating assets, and naming a guardian for minor children. It is not a handwritten will; the sample form serves as a rough draft only.

specs.packaging: Cloth carrying pouch and gift box

record.description: Wooden vehicle puzzles designed for toddlers aged one to three. Four puzzles feature a steamer, airplane, car, and police car in bright colors. Pieces are thick and have smooth rounded edges for small hands. Each puzzle is sized for easy handling, and the set comes in a carrying pouch and gift box.

A low-profile semi-flush ceiling fan with an integrated dimmable LED light and remote control. It has seven blades, three fan speeds, and a warm-white sleep night light. Three color temperatures let you pick the light tone for living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, or studies.

A crystal flush mount ceiling light with a chrome-finished metal dome and 143 K9 crystal balls that catch and reflect light. Suited to entryways, hallways, dining rooms and bedrooms, it uses E26 bulbs and supports dimming.

A halo engagement ring set with a clear cubic zirconia center stone, surrounded by micro-pavé stones that continue along the band. Crafted from rhodium-plated sterling silver, it is nickel free and suited to sensitive skin. Size 7. Suitable for engagements, weddings, or anniversary gifts.

specs.compatibility: iPhone 11, iPhone 11 Pro, iPhone 11 Pro Max
specs.card slots: 3 card slots and a cash slot
specs.features: Built-in stand, auto wake/sleep, precise cutouts

record.description: A wallet-style protective case for iPhone 11, 11 Pro, and 11 Pro Max. It combines a slim TPU shell with a PU leather cover, holds a few cards and some cash, and folds into a stand for viewing video or video calls. Cutouts leave buttons, camera, speaker, and charging port accessible.

specs.window type: Casement, bottom hung, or skylight (not sliding)
specs.fastening: Adhesive hook tape and zipper, no drilling
specs.compatibility: Portable air conditioners and tumble dryers

record.description: A window seal that closes the side gaps of an open casement or awning window around a portable air conditioner's exhaust hose. A zipper closes around the hose so warm exhaust air is less likely to flow back into the room. It attaches with adhesive hook tape, needs no drilling, and is washable. Remove it when cooling season ends.

specs.material: Absorbent polyester fabric with waterproof backing
specs.features: Slip-resistant backing, cuttable edges

record.description: A low-profile kitchen mat for drying dishes, glassware, silverware, pots, and produce. Its absorbent fabric soaks up water while the waterproof backing protects countertops from spills. The slip-resistant base helps it stay in place, and it can be trimmed to fit. Machine washable and made in the USA.

specs.type: Solar charger battery for trail cameras

record.description: A solar charger battery pack for Suntek hunting and game trail cameras, keeping the camera powered in the field. It includes a safeguard circuit against overload and overdischarge, mounts to a tree, pole, or Moultrie tripod, and is weatherproof for indoor and outdoor use.

Men's mesh athletic shorts built for airflow and comfort during workouts. Moisture-wicking Dri-Power fabric helps keep you cool and dry. The elastic waistband with internal draw cord allows an adjustable fit, and side pockets hold small essentials.

Slim-fit long-sleeve women's top with a ribbed knit texture, cross-wrap front, and asymmetrical neckline. Made from a stretchy blend of polyester, cotton, and spandex. Solid plain styling pairs easily with pants, skirts, or jeans for everyday or going-out wear. Runs small, so check the size chart.

Clip-on heel wheels that turn ordinary shoes into roller skates for children. LEDs inside the wheels light up as they spin, with no batteries needed. Adjustable fit, a rubber strap for added security, and larger brakes for stopping. Suitable for ages 6 and up.

Thin graphic art tape for drawing straight, even lines on charts, crafts, decorations, and signs. Its permanent adhesive suits indoor and outdoor use on clean, dry surfaces such as plastic, glass, paper, wood, metal, and ceramic.

specs.assembled dimensions: 54.53 L x 29.92 W x 18.90 H inches
specs.certification: JPMA certified, meets CPSC and ASTM safety standards

record.description: A wooden toddler bed with a PAW Patrol theme from Nick Jr. Built for children from 15 months and up, it has two high side rails to help little sleepers stay safe as they move toward a big kid bed. Quick to put together, and JPMA certified to meet CPSC and ASTM safety standards.

specs.size: 52 in wide x 84 in long per panel
specs.care: Machine wash cold, gentle cycle; tumble dry; do not bleach

record.description: Pair of ivory sheer window panels with a textured linen-style finish and eight grommets at the top for easy hanging. Lets soft natural light through while softening glare and adding some privacy. Suitable for bedrooms, living rooms, and front windows.

specs.included: 2 magnets, 1 black marker with built-in eraser
specs.mounting: Self-stick pads and mounting magnets included

record.description: A small magnetic dry erase whiteboard with an aluminum frame, suited to notes, lists, dates, and drawings. It also works as a bulletin board for attaching items with its magnets. Hang it horizontally or vertically using the included mounting hardware.

specs.contents: 5 sandwich bags, 5 snack bags, 2 large bags
specs.closure: zip lock seal with 2 blue sealing clips
specs.care: hand wash, air dry; not for microwave, oven, or dishwasher

record.description: A 12-piece set of reusable zip-top bags for packing lunches, snacks, and food storage. Made from BPA-free PEVA with a transparent body so contents are easy to see. Includes sandwich, snack, and large sizes plus two sealing clips. Hand wash and air dry; not suitable for microwave, oven, or dishwasher use.
A seven-piece set of long-sleeve bodysuits for baby girls in an assorted pack, sized 18 months. The snap closures are described as sturdy enough to handle frequent wear and washing.

specs.key ingredients: Amla fruit extract, white tea extract, hyaluronic acid, plant ceramides

record.description: A vanilla plant-based protein powder designed to support the body's own collagen production. It blends amla fruit extract, amino acids, and plant proteins, and can be mixed into shakes, smoothies, or coffee. The formula is free of dairy, gluten, soy, and artificial flavors and sweeteners.

Refill bulbs for Wallflowers fragrance plugs, scented with spiced pumpkin, sweet butter, and vanilla cream. Pack includes six bulbs in three twin-packs. Works with any Wallflower plug-in or night-light base. This fragrance has been discontinued, so it is harder to locate.

specs.origin: Eastern Europe (e.g., Russia, Romania, Croatia, Serbia, Ukraine)
specs.contents: Mix of candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, pretzels

record.description: A mixed box of pre-packaged snacks from Eastern European countries. Each box holds a varying assortment of sweets and savory treats, including candy, cookies, chocolates, wafers, biscuits, and pretzels. Contents differ from box to box, so the items you receive may vary from the photos shown.

specs.fitment: Universal manual and automatic vehicles without button
specs.package: 1 shifter knob, 3 rubber adapters, 1 hex spanner, 4 small metal screws

record.description: A black gear shift knob shaped like a skull, with a hand-gripping design. Its resin body has an aluminum alloy attachment. Three adapters let it fit shifter levers of different diameters. It is not suitable for reverse-pull shifters or models with a button.

specs.included: 6 packets of water gels for floating

record.description: Faux plastic pearls in ivory, with no holes for a smooth finish. Suited to vase fillers, table scatter, and home decor for weddings, showers, and anniversaries. Includes six packets of water gels that help the pearls float. Reusable for many events.

specs.product type: Travel system stroller with infant car seat
specs.included items: Modes Bassinet Stroller and SnugRide SnugLock 35 Infant Car Seat
specs.configurations: 3 strollers in 1: infant bassinet, infant car seat carrier, toddler stroller
specs.seat pad care: Spot clean with mild soap and warm water

record.description: A baby travel system from Graco that pairs a Modes stroller with a SnugRide SnugLock 35 infant car seat. The stroller reclines into a bassinet for infants and converts to a toddler seat facing either direction. The car seat clicks directly onto the stroller frame in one step.

specs.included: Tray only; flower box not included

record.description: A white plastic tray sized to hold a 24-inch flower box. It is lightweight, resists fading, and is meant to protect decks, patios, or indoor surfaces. Made in the USA. The flower box shown in product photos is sold separately and is not included.

specs.dimensions: 10.25 x 16 x 5.5 inches (L x W x H)
specs.material: Steel with rust resistant plastic coat
specs.mounting: Snug fit arms for cabinet shelves

record.description: A medium undershelf wire basket that adds a second storage level inside kitchen cabinets. Its snug fit arms attach to cabinet shelves, countertops, or below other shelves. The steel frame has a rust resistant plastic coating and suits spices, napkins, and small kitchen items.

specs.chain: 18 in curb link chain (sold with or without)

record.description: A small heart-shaped locket with room for two photos, finished in 24k gold plating for a warm, solid-gold look. Sold with or without an 18-inch curb chain. Includes a black velvet pouch, making it a simple gift for girls, teens, and women. Backed by the brand's lifetime replacement guarantee.

A compact fountain pen with a brass body in Kaweco's classic historical colours. Its light weight and pocket-friendly size suit everyday carrying. Each pen is handmade and individually checked in Nuremberg, and it offers a fine gold-plated steel nib for a smooth, soft writing feel.

Self-fanning volume lash extensions in blue, designed for lash technicians who are new to hand-made volume fans. A sticky lash strip holds each fan together at the base while you shape it. Available in 14-20mm lengths with 0.07mm thickness.

A wall-mounted coat rack with five metal hooks on a distressed wood board. It suits coats, hats, bags, and umbrellas in entryways, kitchens, or bedrooms. Mounting hardware is included, and the rack is rated to hold up to 30 pounds.

specs.load capacity: 200 pounds or more when installed properly
specs.use: Drying fishing and hunting waders and wader boots

record.description: A stainless steel hanger for drying and storing fishing waders, chest waders, waist waders, hunting waders, and wader boots. Hang them in a closet or from a tree branch to keep them off the ground and help them keep their shape.

specs.exterior: Bonded fleece with grid knit texture
specs.logo: Embroidered Spyder logo on front and label on back

record.description: A men's full-zip jacket with a textured grid-knit fleece exterior and a soft Sherpa fleece lining. Two side zip pockets keep essentials handy. Works well as a mid-layer on cool days or under an insulated shell in colder weather.

specs.dimensions: 23 in high x 16 in wide x 25 in long

record.description: A pet stair that helps dogs reach couches and raised beds. Each step has a slight incline to reduce the number of steps needed. Suitable for small, medium, and large dogs, it has a carpeted tread that can be removed for cleaning.

specs.type: Multifunction pen (black ballpoint, red ballpoint, 0.5mm pencil, stylus, eraser)
specs.engraving: 25 characters free, deep cut color-filled, silver appearance

record.description: A multifunction pen that twists between a black ballpoint, a red ballpoint, and a 0.5mm pencil. The cap holds a stylus for touchscreens and an eraser sits underneath. Slim satin black body with chrome accents, offered with custom name engraving and a lifetime mechanical warranty. Suited to students, teachers, and gift-givers.

Black short-sleeve football fan t-shirt with a Raider graphic and a loyalty slogan across the front. Made from 100% cotton, pre-shrunk, and screen printed in the USA. Machine washable and offered in sizes Small through 5X.

specs.upper: Vegan leather strap with jersey lining
specs.outsole: High density EVA with multi-directional grip

record.description: Casual kids' sandals with a vegan leather strap lined in soft jersey for comfort against the skin. A cushioned EVA footbed offers arch support, and the flexible construction bends with the foot. The molded outsole provides grip on varied surfaces.

specs.fit: Regular, wider at the body with a straight silhouette
specs.fabric feature: Sweat-wicking Climalite with mesh underarm inserts

record.description: A white soccer jersey for kids, inspired by the Real Madrid home kit. It has a relaxed, straight cut, short sleeves, and a crewneck. Made from recycled polyester, it wicks sweat and includes mesh panels under the arms for airflow.

An HDTV video cable for Sega Saturn consoles that works with compatible high-definition televisions. It supports 720p output and aims for a clear picture with crisp audio. The package includes a 7 foot main cable and a 6 foot micro cable.

specs.fits: Oakley Holbrook frames, model numbers starting OO9102
specs.included: Two lenses, frame not included

record.description: Replacement lenses with a dark silver mirror finish and polarization to reduce glare. Designed to fit Oakley Holbrook frames with model numbers starting OO9102. Offers UV protection and a thicker 1.4 mm build for impact resistance. Frame not included; two lenses per pack.

specs.footbed: Molded EVA with arch support, heel cup, and toe bar

record.description: A women's thong sandal built for beach days and time by the water. It has fabric straps, a soft nubuck toe post, and a quick-drying molded footbed. A shock-absorbing midsole and a flexible, slip-resistant rubber outsole round out the design.

A jumbo pet bowl for extra large dogs, with a rubber bottom that grips slippery floors like tile and linoleum. Heavyweight construction helps it stay in place during mealtimes. Dishwasher safe for easy cleaning. Colors vary by unit.

specs.hanging: Ready to frame, or hang with poster mounts, clips, push pins, or thumb tacks

record.description: A large unframed poster featuring a grid-style LEGO Batman design, printed with high-resolution artwork on gloss paper. It is officially licensed and suits bedrooms, kids' rooms, game rooms, offices, and dorms, and can be framed or pinned up.

specs.colors_included: Blue stripe, orange gators, gray stripe

record.description: A three-pack of sleeveless toddler tank tops for boys in assorted blue, orange, and gray patterns. Each tank has a ribbed neckline and a pocket detail. Sized 3T and packaged tag-less for everyday wear.

specs.shipping: Sold and shipped flat in pallet quantities

record.description: Large double wall corrugated bottom for consolidating multiple-piece shipments and packing bulky, irregularly shaped items. Made from kraft corrugated board rated 275 pounds. Sold flat by the pallet and designed to work with a matching Gaylord lid.

specs.features: USB charging port, headphone hole, anti-theft interlayer
specs.compartments: 2 main zippered pockets and 1 front zippered pocket

record.description: A compact crossbody sling bag for men, made from water-resistant PU leather with adjustable nylon straps. It has two main compartments, a front zippered pocket, and an anti-theft interlayer. An external USB port with built-in cable and a side earphone hole make it handy for travel, cycling, and everyday use.

specs.design: older woman and young girl holding hands
specs.enclosure card: The best gift is time spent with you

record.description: A hand-painted resin figure showing an older woman in a cream dress seated beside a young girl in a cream dress, holding hands on a gray bench. Designed to celebrate the bond between grandparent and child, it can join other pieces in a family grouping. Ready to display on a shelf, table, or mantel.

A heavy-duty multitool with 21 tools, including large pliers, long blades, replaceable wire cutters, and spring-action scissors. Opens one-handed, with all-locking features for confident use. Comes with a lanyard ring and a nylon sheath for carrying on the go.

specs.included: Matching chef hat with velcro fastener

record.description: A short-sleeved double-breasted chef's coat for women, sold with a matching chef hat. The hat uses a velcro fastener to adjust to different head sizes. Choose size using the bust measurement in the size chart.

Neoprene diving gloves for snorkeling, kayaking, surfing, and other water sports. The 3MM material is meant to keep hands warm and the textured palm helps with grip. An adjustable velcro strap at the wrist adds a snug fit. Hand-wash in cool water and dry out of direct sunlight.

specs.care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

record.description: Denim shortalls with a cuffed hem, several pockets, adjustable straps, and a center front zipper. Made with LYCRA, and machine washable in cold water with low-heat drying.

specs.ports: 4 x USB 3.0, 1 x USB-C power delivery
specs.compatibility: MacBook Pro/Air with Thunderbolt 3, Surface Pro 7, Chromebook, Windows laptops

record.description: A compact USB-C hub that adds four USB 3.0 ports for keyboards, mice, flash drives and external drives. It is plug and play with no external driver needed, and its USB-C port passes through up to 60W of charging power to a compatible laptop. The aluminum body has an LED indicator and fits easily in a laptop bag.

A 18 by 24 inch art poster featuring Alex Grey's artwork titled Oversoul. Listed as an official item and described as museum quality, it suits framing or display as wall art. The listing presents the image as a visual exploration of human consciousness linking to wider cosmic awareness.

specs.included: Shoulder bag

record.description: A foldable rocking chair for camping and outdoor use. Its powder-coated steel frame supports up to 300 pounds, and its breathable mesh seat rocks smoothly on a low-profile base that locks in place. A carry bag makes it easy to transport and store.

Two size D batteries themed after the Good Guys doll from the movie Child's Play 2. Officially presented by Trick or Treat Studios and Universal Studios, this pack is meant as an accessory for fans who own the doll.
